films.title: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
films.engine: A painter is hired to study a young woman in secret so her likeness can be sent to the man she is to be married to, a marriage she inherited from a dead sister. The two women use the few days the mother is away to have the thing they know they cannot keep. What the film turns on is the decision to hold onto the memory of it rather than fight for the person.

predicaments.situation: one is paid to observe another in secret
predicaments.basis: Marianne is engaged as a walking companion so she can memorize Héloïse's face and paint her without her consent, and later confesses it and destroys the portrait.

predicaments.situation: two people love inside a fixed deadline
predicaments.basis: The five days the Countess spends on the mainland are the whole span Marianne and Héloïse have before the portrait is approved and the marriage proceeds.

predicaments.situation: a daughter is given away to a stranger
predicaments.basis: Héloïse is betrothed to a Milanese nobleman she has never met, and her mother's only concern is that the portrait be finished so the match can go ahead.

predicaments.situation: looking back costs the lover the beloved
predicaments.basis: They argue over why Orpheus turns around, Héloïse proposing that Eurydice asked him to, and at the door Héloïse calls "turn around" so Marianne's last sight of her is the wedding dress.

predicaments.situation: a death in the family goes unexplained
predicaments.basis: The older sister's suicide is never accounted for and its only consequence is that Héloïse is recalled from the convent to take the marriage that was hers.

predicaments.situation: the powerless are helped in secret
predicaments.basis: Marianne and Héloïse take the housemaid Sophie to have an abortion and stay with her through it, then have her lie back down in the scene so it can be looked at.

films.title: The Tree of Life
films.engine: Two parents raise three boys on opposite instructions — the world must be fought, the world must be received — in a house where one man's temper sets the weather each day. One son dies at nineteen and is never explained. The surviving brother spends decades unable to settle whose son he is, and the film ends by staging the handing back of the dead boy.

predicaments.situation: a household is ruled by one man's temper
predicaments.basis: Mr. O'Brien screams at his wife, blames her softness for the boys' disobedience, and the family visibly lightens the week he is away on business.

predicaments.situation: a death in the family goes unexplained
predicaments.basis: R.L. dies at nineteen, his mother asks God why in voiceover, and decades later the father still has not gotten over it and cannot talk to his surviving son.

predicaments.situation: a son becomes the parent he swore against
predicaments.basis: Jack resents his father's harshness but tells him at the end that he resembles him rather than his mother, and the father was himself driven by terror of ending up like his own failed father.

predicaments.situation: a father asks his son to forgive him

predicaments.situation: one parent's gentleness leaves the children unprotected

predicaments.situation: a child is sent away from the household
predicaments.basis: In the extended version, Mr. O'Brien recognizes his own failure as a father and sends the academically declining Jack to boarding school for a better chance.

films.title: There Will Be Blood
films.engine: A prospector adopts the orphan of a dead worker so investors will see a family man, and spends thirty years trading public humiliations with a young preacher whose land and congregation he needs. Every attachment he has is an instrument — the boy, the brother who turns up, the church. When the boy grows up and asks to become his own man, he tells him exactly what he was for.

predicaments.situation: a child is taken in to be useful
predicaments.basis: Daniel adopts H.W. after the boy's father dies in a drilling accident, specifically to pass himself off as a family man to investors, and finally tells him he was only ever a useful face.

predicaments.situation: a child is sent away from the household
predicaments.basis: After the gas blowout deafens H.W. and the boy sets fire to their shack, Daniel restrains him and puts him on a train to a school for the deaf in San Francisco.

predicaments.situation: two rivals each need what the other holds
predicaments.basis: Daniel needs the Sunday land and the easement across Bandy's ranch, Eli needs Daniel's money for his church, and neither can get it without submitting to the other in public.

predicaments.situation: humiliation is repaid with humiliation
predicaments.basis: Daniel beats Eli in the mud over the money he is owed, Eli later forces him to confess abandoning his child at the baptism, and Daniel makes Eli denounce his faith before killing him.

predicaments.situation: a stranger claims kinship to be taken in
predicaments.basis: A man arrives calling himself Daniel's half-brother Henry, is exposed when he misses a childhood joke, admits he only knew the real Henry, and is shot and buried.

predicaments.situation: a grown child asks to be released
predicaments.basis: H.W. asks to dissolve the partnership and start his own company in Mexico with Mary, and Daniel answers by mocking his deafness and disowning him.

films.title: The White Ribbon
films.engine: In a village where a pastor, a doctor and a landowner discipline everyone beneath them, someone keeps maiming and humiliating the powerful and the children who cannot defend themselves. Nobody is ever caught; the adults reach for outsiders to blame, and the one man who says aloud that the punished children may be the ones punishing is threatened with jail. The film is about the transmission downward of what is done in the name of purity.

predicaments.situation: the harm has no author anyone can name
predicaments.basis: The wire that unhorses the doctor, the caning of the baron's son, the near-blinding of the midwife's handicapped boy and the barn fire are never solved, and the narrator leaves for the war with only rumours behind him.

predicaments.situation: those punished pass the punishment to the weaker
predicaments.basis: The children raised under the pastor's white ribbons and the steward's beatings are the ones the schoolteacher believes maimed the estate's son, the midwife's disabled boy and the pastor's bird.

predicaments.situation: naming the suspicion gets the speaker silenced

predicaments.situation: a father preys on his own daughter

films.title: Memories of Murder
films.engine: Two detectives who cannot agree on what counts as knowing — one claims to read guilt in a man's eyes, the other reads reports and weather — work the same string of killings for years. The pressure to produce a culprit makes them break the people nearest to hand, including a handicapped boy who turns out to have witnessed one of the murders. By the end each has taken up the other's method, the man is still out there, and the only description of him is that he looks like anyone.

predicaments.situation: the harm has no author anyone can name
predicaments.basis: The killings go unsolved for seventeen years, the lab result neither confirms nor excludes the one suspect, and the last account of the man is that he was too ordinary to describe.

predicaments.situation: the weak are made to confess by force
predicaments.basis: Cho beats the mentally handicapped Baek into confessing, and the man caught at the crime scene improvises a confession that matches none of the details.

predicaments.situation: two men with opposite methods must work together
predicaments.basis: Park's eye-contact intuition and Seo's study of crime reports collide, they fight when the innocent man is released, and after the next killing they agree to work the case together.

predicaments.situation: a pursuer is changed by the one pursued
predicaments.basis: Seo, who arrived rejecting forced confessions, ends up trying to shoot an unproven suspect, while Park, who claimed to know a criminal by sight, is the one who stops him.

predicaments.situation: the only witness dies before he can speak

films.title: Tropical Malady
films.engine: A soldier posted to a rural town and a young man from the village fall into an easy courtship that ends when one of them wanders off into the dark mid-embrace. The film then begins again with a soldier alone in the forest, sent to destroy a spirit that wears that same man's face. The hunt strips him of gun, radio and upright walking, and finishes with him offering himself to be taken instead.

films.title: The Act of Killing
films.engine: Men who killed on a mass scale were never punished for it; they became powerful, and they tell the story of what they did as a story of heroism. A filmmaker invites them to stage their killings as scenes, and the staging — costumes, camera, one of them playing a prisoner — brings one man to feel from the inside what he spent decades describing from the outside.

films.title: Grizzly Man
films.engine: A man spent five summers camping among wild bears, filming himself with them, convinced he had won their trust and was defending them; in his sixth autumn one killed him and his girlfriend. What survives him is a hundred hours of his own footage and the people who knew him — and a narrator — arguing over whether what they see in it is love, self-invention, or a fatal misreading.

predicaments.basis: Timothy Treadwell approaches and pets bears he says have accepted him, and stays into October when the animals are feeding hard for hibernation; he and Amie Huguenard are killed.

predicaments.situation: someone is known only through what they left

predicaments.situation: the living decide what the dead leave behind
predicaments.basis: Jewel Palovak inherits his belongings and the tape; Herzog first tells her to destroy it, later calls that advice stupid, praises her putting it in a bank vault, and around 2023 she destroys it anyway.

films.title: Killers of the Flower Moon
films.engine: Osage families grow rich from oil under their land, and a white rancher who plays their friend arranges for the money to pass to his own family by having them killed one at a time. His nephew marries into one such family, does the arranging, keeps the marriage and the children, and slowly poisons his wife while sitting at her bedside.

films.title: Aftersun
films.engine: An eleven-year-old spends a package holiday in Turkey with her thirty-year-old father, filming him on a camcorder and half-noticing the despair he is covering with cheerfulness — the self-help books, the refusal to sing, the night walk into the sea. Twenty years later, herself a parent, she plays the tape back trying to find in it the man she was too young to see, and cannot hold onto him.

films.title: Midsommar
films.engine: A woman loses her whole family in one night and stays with a boyfriend who had already decided to leave her, so that neither of them can be honest about what they are to each other. He takes her along on a trip he didn't want her on, into a village whose people answer her weeping by weeping with her, out loud, in a circle. The film is the slow exchange of a partner who will not hold her for a crowd that will, and the price the crowd charges for it.

films.engine: A dying ruler tells his son he is not fit to rule and names the general he trusts instead; the son kills his father, takes the throne, and has the general's wife and child murdered. The general survives as a slave and comes back into his sight as an anonymous fighter the crowd adores. What drives it is that the son cannot make anyone love him the way they loved the two men he removed, and the man he wronged only has to stay alive in front of him.

predicaments.situation: a son learns his father preferred another
predicaments.basis: Marcus Aurelius tells Maximus he wants him as regent because Commodus is unfit to rule; Commodus, on hearing it, kills his father.

predicaments.situation: a man survives the killing of his household
predicaments.basis: Maximus kills his escort and rides home wounded to find his wife and son already murdered, buries them, and collapses.

predicaments.situation: the wronged returns disguised among the powerful
predicaments.basis: Sold to Proximo and brought to the Colosseum in a masked helmet, Maximus fights before the emperor who believes him dead, then removes the helmet and names himself.

predicaments.situation: the watching crowd decides a man's fate
predicaments.basis: The spectators force Commodus to spare Maximus after he reveals himself, and chant "Maximus the Merciful" when he refuses to finish Tigris.

predicaments.situation: one loves both sides of a war
predicaments.basis: Lucilla is Commodus' sister and Maximus' former lover, conspiring with Maximus and Gracchus while her brother threatens her son.

relatives.title: Ran
relatives.shares: a ruler's decision about who succeeds him destroys the house from inside

relatives.title: The Bad Sleep Well
relatives.shares: a wronged man returns unrecognized into the household of the one who ruined his family

relatives.title: Ben-Hur
relatives.shares: an enslaved man survives the destruction of his family and comes back through the arena

relatives.title: The Count of Monte Cristo
relatives.shares: the wronged returns under another identity among the people who wronged him

relatives.title: Spartacus
relatives.shares: a slave's standing with the crowd becomes the only power he has against the state

films.title: A Serious Man
films.engine: A physics teacher's wife tells him she is leaving for a family friend, his brother is falling apart on his couch, his job is being attacked by letters no one will sign, and a student's father has arranged things so that both honesty and dishonesty are punishable. He goes to three men whose office it is to explain such things, and gets a story about teeth, some advice about perspective, and a closed door. The film turns on a man who keeps asking why and is answered only by more of it.

predicaments.situation: a spouse announces they love someone else
predicaments.basis: Judith tells Larry she wants a get so she can marry Sy Ableman, then she and Sy install Larry and his brother in a motel and she empties the bank accounts.

predicaments.situation: the appointed authorities cannot answer the question
predicaments.basis: Larry asks Rabbi Scott, who suggests a change of perspective, Rabbi Nachtner, who tells the story of the goy's teeth and never finishes it, and cannot get in to see Marshak at all.

predicaments.situation: a choice is imposed with no innocent option
predicaments.basis: Clive's father tells Larry he will sue for defamation if Larry reports the envelope of cash and sue for the money if Larry does not give Clive a passing grade.

predicaments.situation: an unnamed accuser cannot be confronted
predicaments.basis: Larry's department head tells him anonymous letters have been urging the tenure committee to turn him down, and it is only at the bar mitzvah that Judith says Sy had written to the committee.

predicaments.situation: a man is left carrying a failing brother
predicaments.basis: Arthur sleeps on the couch draining his cyst and writing the Mentaculus, faces gambling and solicitation charges, and sends Larry a three-thousand-dollar legal bill.

relatives.title: The Trial (1962)
relatives.shares: a man seeks an explanation from those licensed to give one and receives parables instead

relatives.title: Dekalog: One
relatives.shares: an orderly, rational man's household is undone by something his framework cannot account for

relatives.title: Ikiru
relatives.shares: a diagnosis arrives on a man already sunk in obligations nobody will explain to him

relatives.title: Silence
relatives.shares: a man addresses the authority above him about his suffering and gets no reply

relatives.title: Barton Fink
relatives.shares: a man is squeezed by neighbours, employers and family while asking what any of it means

films.title: Inland Empire
films.engine: An actress takes the lead in a remake of a film abandoned after its two leads were murdered "inside the story", and the part starts arriving in her life: the affair her character has, the husband who threatens consequences, the woman with the screwdriver. Somewhere else a young woman sits locked in a hotel room crying at a television, and what the actress goes through is what eventually lets that woman walk out and find her family.

predicaments.situation: a person is made to live another's life
predicaments.basis: Nikki, cast as Sue in On High in Blue Tomorrows, stops being able to separate script from life — she begins the affair, acquires the abusive husband, and is stabbed on Hollywood Boulevard.

predicaments.situation: lovers proceed despite a warning of consequences
predicaments.basis: Devon is warned not to sleep with Nikki given his history on sets, and Piotrek warns him of dark consequences for wrong actions; they become lovers during the shoot.

predicaments.situation: the wronged wife comes for the other woman
predicaments.basis: Sue confronts Billy in front of his family professing love, Doris slaps her repeatedly, and later stabs her with the screwdriver Sue was carrying for protection.

predicaments.situation: one is compelled to kill by another's will
predicaments.basis: The woman with the screwdriver tells the policeman she was hypnotized to kill someone, and remembers it was the Phantom from the Polish circus who set her on Sue.

predicaments.situation: one is freed by another's suffering
predicaments.basis: The Lost Girl watches events on the hotel television in tears, and only when Nikki shoots the Phantom and reaches Room 47 to embrace her can she leave and rejoin her husband and son.

predicaments.situation: one is beaten inside her own home
predicaments.basis: In the Inland Empire house, Nikki lives as Smithy's wife in a marriage of physical abuse that Polish men periodically visit.

relatives.title: Persona
relatives.shares: two women's identities bleed together until one is carrying what belongs to the other

relatives.title: Opening Night
relatives.shares: an actress cannot keep the part she is playing out of her own life

relatives.title: Vertigo
relatives.shares: a woman is made to perform a role scripted for her by someone else

relatives.title: The Double Life of Véronique
relatives.shares: one woman's ordeal, at a distance, spares or releases another she has never met

relatives.title: Belle de Jour
relatives.shares: a woman's second life among prostitutes is impossible to separate from her waking one

films.title: Eureka
films.engine: Three people walk off the same hijacked bus alive and none of them can go back to their lives: the two children stop speaking and are left alone in the house after their mother leaves and their father dies, and the driver cannot drive or stay married. He moves in with them and cooks, and the assembled household holds even after it becomes clear that the boy has been killing women in the neighbourhood. What the film turns on is who is willing to keep sitting with damaged people once the damage starts coming out.

predicaments.situation: survivors of the same violence cannot resume living
predicaments.basis: Makoto, Naoki and Kozue are the only ones left after the bus hijacking; the children stop attending school and stop speaking, and Makoto cannot drive a bus again and takes day-labour work.

predicaments.situation: a mourner is comforted by strangers not intimates
predicaments.basis: After their mother abandons the family and their father dies in a crash, the mute Tamura children are fed and housed not by relatives but by the bus driver, while their student cousin Akihiko turns up with nothing but cynicism.

predicaments.situation: an old injury returns as violence on strangers
predicaments.basis: Naoki, silent since the hijacking, turns out to be the one murdering women in the neighbourhood, including a friend of Makoto's.

predicaments.situation: a protector must deliver the one protected
predicaments.basis: Makoto works out that the boy he has been feeding and housing is the killer, confronts him, and talks him into turning himself in.

predicaments.situation: one is accused repeatedly without any evidence
predicaments.basis: The detective from the hijacking harasses Makoto over the first killing and arrests him after the second, then has to let him go.

relatives.title: The Sweet Hereafter
relatives.shares: a town's survivors of one vehicle disaster cannot rejoin ordinary life afterwards

relatives.title: Nobody Knows
relatives.shares: children abandoned by a parent keep a household running alone after the adults leave

relatives.title: Manchester by the Sea
relatives.shares: a man who cannot re-enter his own life takes charge of a bereaved young person

relatives.title: Ordinary People
relatives.shares: a family that shared a violent accident splinters while one member goes silent

relatives.title: Ratcatcher
relatives.shares: a child carries a death he was present at and no adult can reach him

films.title: Princess Mononoke
films.engine: A young man is cursed by a god that was driven mad by a bullet fired hundreds of miles away, and travels west to find who is responsible — arriving at a town whose leader shelters lepers and former prostitutes by stripping the mountains and shooting the gods that live there. He ends up defending both the town and the forest against each other, alongside a human girl the wolves raised who will not be counted as human. Neither side will stop, and he will not choose.

predicaments.situation: an old injury returns as violence on strangers
predicaments.basis: Eboshi's iron ball, lodged in the boar god Nago, turns him into a demon that attacks Ashitaka's village far to the east and leaves a curse on his arm that will kill him.

predicaments.situation: a peacemaker is turned away by both sides
predicaments.basis: Ashitaka pulls San and Eboshi apart mid-duel and is shot by a townsperson for it, then banished from the forest by Moro when he asks to leave with San.

roles.other side: Moro, San and the animal gods

predicaments.situation: a child is raised by her people's enemies
predicaments.basis: San is a human girl raised by the wolf goddess Moro, fights the humans destroying the forest, and refuses the name of human even after admitting she loves Ashitaka.

predicaments.situation: a refuge is built by ruining its neighbours
predicaments.basis: Irontown takes in lepers and former prostitutes and gives them work and standing, and pays for it by deforesting the mountain, mining iron and shooting the gods who live there.

predicaments.situation: one loves both sides of a war
predicaments.basis: San loves Ashitaka, who has chosen to stay and rebuild the human town, while she cannot forgive humanity.

predicaments.situation: the war ends without the lovers uniting
predicaments.basis: After the Forest Spirit's head is returned and the land regrows, San stays in the forest and Ashitaka stays in Irontown, promising to visit her.

relatives.title: The Mission
relatives.shares: a settlement's prosperity requires destroying the people already living on the land

relatives.title: Dances with Wolves
relatives.shares: a man ends up belonging to both sides of a war neither side will end

relatives.title: Dersu Uzala
relatives.shares: a way of living tied to the forest is extinguished by those who are clearing it

relatives.title: West Side Story
relatives.shares: two people love each other across a feud that neither of their sides will drop

relatives.title: The Searchers
relatives.shares: a child raised by the people her kin call enemies cannot simply be returned

films.title: Flowers of Shanghai
films.engine: In these houses a patron and a courtesan can spend five years behaving like a married couple and still have no way of becoming one; everything that happens is people trying to convert money, habit and long affection into a standing that money cannot actually buy. One woman is put aside when a younger one is preferred, one reaches for poison when the promise of marriage collapses, and one simply haggles her way out at an agreed price.

predicaments.situation: a partner is set aside for someone new
predicaments.basis: Master Wang ends a four-or-five year arrangement with Crimson after being refused her hand and turns to the younger Jasmin, whom he agrees to marry before leaving for Guangdong.

predicaments.situation: two lovers are refused permission to marry
predicaments.basis: Jade and the immature Master Zhu have sworn to die together if they cannot be married, and when the marriage clearly will not happen she doses him with opium and turns the rest on herself; Wang's request for Crimson's hand is refused in the same way.

predicaments.situation: a deception is uncovered by the one deceived
predicaments.basis: Wang discovers Crimson has been keeping an actor and drinks himself into a rage over it, and it later emerges in other people's conversation that Jasmin had been sleeping with his own nephew.

predicaments.situation: release must be bought from those holding one
predicaments.basis: Emerald, bought as a child for $100, spends the film negotiating against her auntie's demand of $3,000 and, backed by Luo and Master Hong, settles on a price and walks out free.

predicaments.situation: a woman's life is decided by others
predicaments.basis: The flower girls were purchased as children and their attachments, prices and departures are settled in conversations among patrons and madams that they attend but do not control.

predicaments.situation: intoxication releases what was being held back
predicaments.basis: Wang, who keeps every feeling behind the etiquette of the rooms, only lets his jealousy out once he is drunk over Crimson's affair.

relatives.title: Camille
relatives.shares: a paid attachment that lasts like a marriage and is denied the standing of one

relatives.title: The Age of Innocence
relatives.shares: an attachment governed entirely by etiquette, where the refusal is never spoken aloud

relatives.title: The Life of Oharu
relatives.shares: a woman whose price is set by others from childhood onward

relatives.title: In the Mood for Love
relatives.shares: feeling conducted through rooms, meals and manners rather than declaration

relatives.title: House of Pleasures
relatives.shares: women inside a house whose only exit is a sum of money someone must agree to

films.title: Platform
films.engine: A group of small-town performers spend a decade wanting to be elsewhere — on a train, on tour, in the city — while the country loosens around them, and the film is about what becomes of that wanting when it has nowhere to land. The man who chases one woman for ten years, is told they are incompatible, and keeps not contacting her, ends up married to her with a son, in business, in the same town, with the pull gone.

predicaments.situation: someone keeps returning to a person already lost
predicaments.basis: Cui pursues Yin for years, is told outright they are incompatible, pines through every tour without contacting her, and finally visits her again once she is a tax collector — they marry and have a son.

predicaments.situation: a woman's life is decided by others
predicaments.basis: Zhang gets Zhong pregnant and forces her into an abortion that wrecks the relationship; Yin's military-official father decides who may court her.

predicaments.situation: private life is policed by the authorities
predicaments.basis: Zhang and Zhong's out-of-wedlock relationship is discovered and they are interrogated over it, and the troupe cannot get permits to perform and ends up playing beside highways.

predicaments.situation: one is sacrificed so another may rise
predicaments.basis: Cui's cousin Sanming signs on at an unregulated coal mine so his sister Wenying can afford university, and sends her five yuan with the message never to come back.

predicaments.situation: one leaves the other behind
predicaments.basis: When the privatised troupe goes on the road, Yin chooses to stay in Fenyang while Cui, Zhang and Zhong tour as far as Inner Mongolia.

predicaments.situation: someone returns to the place they left
predicaments.basis: Every tour ends back in Fenyang, and the last return finds Cui's parents' marriage broken, his father remarried behind a shop counter, and Cui himself out of the troupe selling construction materials.

relatives.title: The Last Picture Show
relatives.shares: a small town where some leave and some stay and the decade closes over both

relatives.title: Yi Yi
relatives.shares: a man returning to the woman who refused him years earlier, after the wanting has cooled

relatives.title: Amarcord
relatives.shares: provincial young people whose desires are all aimed at a world arriving from elsewhere

relatives.title: Aparajito
relatives.shares: one family member's schooling paid for by another's exhausting labour

relatives.title: American Graffiti
relatives.shares: a night of restlessness that decides which of the friends actually gets out

films.title: Infernal Affairs
films.engine: Two young men are planted inside each other's organisations and spend ten years becoming the cover story; the film is about which of them gets to keep the name he was actually given. One has the truth and no way to prove it once the only man who could vouch for him is thrown off a roof; the other has all the proof and no claim to it, and would rather be the good man on paper than the one he is.

predicaments.situation: a person must pretend to be someone else
predicaments.basis: Chan is publicly expelled from the academy to infiltrate Hon's triad and fears he is turning into a real criminal, while Lau is sent from the triad into the police and rises to Senior Inspector wanting to keep that life.

predicaments.situation: one cannot prove the truth about oneself
predicaments.basis: Chan tells his psychiatrist he is a cop as though it were a joke, and after Wong's death Lau seizes his identity file, leaving him with no record of being who he is until the file surfaces six months after he is shot.

predicaments.situation: one sends another into danger from safety
predicaments.basis: Superintendent Wong runs Chan as his sole contact and Hon runs Lau the same way, each handler racing to find the other's man while the planted men absorb the risk.

predicaments.situation: an innocent is accused to save oneself
predicaments.basis: Hon concludes the dead henchman Keung was the mole, and the internal affairs case is finally closed by pinning everything on Big B, leaving Lau's record clean.

predicaments.situation: a plea to begin again is refused
predicaments.basis: Disarmed on the rooftop, Lau says calmly that he wants to start over as a good person and asks Chan to help bury his past; Chan refuses.

predicaments.situation: a deception is uncovered by the one deceived
predicaments.basis: Chan works out that Lau was the mole the moment they meet at headquarters, and the CD Chan sends is played by Lau's fiancée Mary, who learns what he is.

relatives.title: Donnie Brasco
relatives.shares: a man kept undercover so long the assumed self starts outweighing the real one

relatives.title: The Lives of Others
relatives.shares: a watcher whose own conduct is what the investigation would expose

relatives.title: Army of Shadows
relatives.shares: an operative whose existence depends on a handler who can be killed

relatives.title: The Return of Martin Guerre
relatives.shares: a man with no way to prove which name is truly his

relatives.title: Sleeping Dogs / The Wages of Fear
relatives.shares: loyalty to a side that will disown you the moment you are inconvenient

films.title: The Day He Arrives
films.engine: A man who used to direct films comes back to the city where he was somebody, and the days start folding into each other — the same neighbourhood walked twice, the same actress run into and parted from, the same drinking, and finally a bar owner who looks like the girlfriend he left. The film is about someone circling a life he has already had, unable to tell a second chance from a repetition.

predicaments.situation: someone returns to the place they left
predicaments.basis: Seong-jun comes to Seoul to see a friend and instead wanders Bukchon and Insa-dong, revisiting the library where he first chased a woman.

predicaments.situation: the same encounter happens again slightly differently
predicaments.basis: He meets the actress and parts from her, then meets her again on what may or may not be another day; the friend, the professor and the bar recur with the day markers removed.

predicaments.situation: someone keeps returning to a person already lost
predicaments.basis: Drunk, he goes to his ex-girlfriend's house, and afterwards attaches himself to the owner of the bar Novel, who strikingly resembles her.

roles.returned to: the ex-girlfriend and the bar owner who resembles her

predicaments.situation: a person is defined by work already abandoned
predicaments.basis: Film students at the next table recognise him and invite him over because he used to be a director; he no longer is.

predicaments.situation: intoxication releases what was being held back
predicaments.basis: Each drinking session ends with him doing what he would not do sober — going to his ex's house, playing piano for the owner, kissing her.

relatives.title: Vertigo
relatives.shares: a man drawn to a woman because she resembles the one he lost

relatives.title: Last Year at Marienbad
relatives.shares: encounters that may be repetitions or first meetings, with no way to settle which

relatives.title: Groundhog Day
relatives.shares: the same day recurring with small variations until the man is the only variable

relatives.title: Certified Copy
relatives.shares: a relationship that could be a decade old or an hour old depending on which reading you take

relatives.title: 8½
relatives.shares: a director who has stopped directing, drifting among people who still address him as one

films.title: No Bears
films.engine: A filmmaker forbidden to make films or leave the country parks himself in a village at the border and directs, over a livestream from a rented room, a story about two people trying to get out — while the village around him demands he surrender a photograph he insists he never took. Two couples are destroyed on either side of him, one by a betrothal made at a girl's birth and one by a lie told inside his own production, and his camera is implicated in both.

predicaments.situation: one cannot prove the truth about oneself
predicaments.basis: Panahi denies photographing Gozal and Solduz, shows every image on his camera, hands the memory card to the sheriff, and is still required to go to the swearing room and swear over the Quran because nothing he offers counts as proof.

predicaments.situation: two lovers are refused permission to marry
predicaments.basis: Gozal's umbilical cord was cut in Jacob's name at birth, so her love for Solduz is treated as a dishonour to be stopped; the pair plan to elope and are shot dead trying to cross the border.

predicaments.situation: a woman's life is decided by others
predicaments.basis: The village's custom assigns a girl a husband at her birth, and the men then negotiate over Gozal's future with her father and Solduz's father while she pleads with an outsider about a photograph.

predicaments.situation: release must be bought from those holding one
predicaments.basis: Bakhtiar and Zara can only leave after years of abuse by buying fake passports from smugglers, and Reza separately arranges with people smugglers to move Panahi over the same border.

predicaments.situation: one sends another into danger from safety
predicaments.basis: Panahi directs Bakhtiar and Zara through a screen while they re-enact their own flight on the far side of a border he will not cross himself, and calls cut over the body of the woman who drowned.

predicaments.situation: a deception is uncovered by the one deceived
predicaments.basis: Zara stops the shoot to tell the camera that Bakhtiar's passport is a prop and worthless, that she would have to go alone, and after ten years of abuse it is this lie that finishes her.

relatives.title: Dogville
relatives.shares: an outsider's presence turning a village's rules into machinery aimed at him

relatives.title: The Crucible
relatives.shares: a community that will accept only a sworn oath where evidence is offered

relatives.title: Mustang
relatives.shares: girls whose marriages are settled by the household before they have any say

relatives.title: Rashomon
relatives.shares: testimony sworn about what was and was not seen, with truth unrecoverable

relatives.title: The White Ribbon
relatives.shares: a village enforcing its order through pressure, honour and silence rather than law

films.title: Persepolis
films.engine: A girl grows up while the state that replaced the one her family marched against jails and executes the relatives who taught her to speak her mind, then is shipped abroad for her own safety and comes back belonging to neither place. Her grandmother's single instruction — never sell your integrity for your own comfort — is the standard she breaks, in a street, with a lie that could have got a stranger arrested, and spends the rest of the film returning to.

predicaments.situation: private life is policed by the authorities
predicaments.basis: Dress and headscarves are imposed by law, Marji and Reza's families are fined for the two holding hands in public, and a party is raided by the fundamentalist police, killing Nima as he flees over the rooftops.

predicaments.situation: a child is sent away for their safety
predicaments.basis: After Marji is expelled for contradicting a teacher about government abuses, her parents put her on a plane to a French lycée in Vienna to keep her from being arrested.

predicaments.situation: one leaves the other behind
predicaments.basis: Marji leaves twice; the second time her mother forbids her ever to return, and her grandmother dies soon after her departure.

predicaments.situation: a person must pretend to be someone else
predicaments.basis: At a party in Vienna she claims to be French, and hears her grandmother's voice telling her to stay true to herself as she walks out.

predicaments.situation: an innocent is accused to save oneself
predicaments.basis: Stopped for wearing makeup, Marji points at a man standing nearby and says he made indecent comments to her; her grandmother, whose husband and son died for their beliefs, tells her never to trade her integrity like that.

predicaments.situation: a deception is uncovered by the one deceived
predicaments.basis: Marji's relationship with Markus ends when she catches him with another woman, and shortly after Frau Schloss accuses her of theft and she loses her room.

relatives.title: Brooklyn
relatives.shares: a young woman sent abroad who returns to find she belongs fully to neither country

relatives.title: The Lives of Others
relatives.shares: private conduct — music, clothes, company — treated as the state's business

relatives.title: Wadjda
relatives.shares: a girl testing, in small daily acts, the rules that govern what women may do in public

relatives.title: Au revoir les enfants
relatives.shares: a child kept alive by adults' secrecy and marked for life by one careless betrayal

relatives.title: The Emigrants
relatives.shares: a family split by departure, with those who leave and those who stay never made whole

films.title: Nine Queens
films.engine: Two swindlers spend one day trying to sell a forged sheet of rare stamps to a rich collector who is being deported tomorrow, each of them watching the other for the moment he will be cut out. The day is itself a piece of theatre: the younger man, the sister, the thieves and the buyer are all working together to take back from the elder what he once took from his own family.

predicaments.situation: a slight is repaid years later
predicaments.basis: Marcos cheated his sister Valeria and younger brother Federico out of the family inheritance, and the entire stamp scheme is their staged retaliation, ending with him $200,000 lighter.

predicaments.situation: two partners each expect the other to betray
predicaments.basis: Marcos recruits Juan for a single day, Juan grows suspicious when the shortfall matches his savings exactly, and Marcos stages a mugging to take the check.

predicaments.situation: a brother trades his sister's body for gain
predicaments.basis: When the buyer makes sex with Valeria a condition of purchase, Marcos accepts, and she sets her own price: that he confess to Federico what he did to them.

predicaments.situation: a child owes a parent an impossible sum
predicaments.basis: Juan's stated reason for taking the job is the $70,000 needed to bribe a judge at his imprisoned con-artist father's hearing, and he visits the jail before committing.

predicaments.situation: a promised payment turns out to be worthless
predicaments.basis: The certified check from the buyer becomes paper when the bank collapses overnight from its own management's fraud.

relatives.title: The Sting
relatives.shares: a whole world staged around a mark who believes he is running the play

relatives.title: The Handmaiden
relatives.shares: a scheme in which the apparent junior partner is the one running it back on the schemer

relatives.title: The Grifters
relatives.shares: people who cheat for a living cannot stop cheating their own family

relatives.title: House of Games
relatives.shares: a day-long partnership in which trust is the instrument of the con

relatives.title: Matchstick Men
relatives.shares: a con man's closest tie turns out to be the setup

films.title: Honeyland
films.engine: A woman who lives alone with her dying mother keeps wild bees by a single rule — take half the honey, leave half for the bees. When a herding family moves in beside her she teaches them the trade and gives them bees, and a buyer's demand pushes the man to take everything; his starved hives destroy hers. She is left with no bees, no mother, and no neighbours.

predicaments.situation: taking more than can be replaced ruins everyone
predicaments.basis: Hussein sells his whole stock instead of leaving half for his colonies, and through the scarce winter his bees attack and collapse Hatidže's.

predicaments.situation: a lesson given is turned against the giver
predicaments.basis: Hatidže shows Hussein how to find and collect wild honey and hands him bees to start with, and it is those hives that finish hers.

predicaments.situation: a grown child tends a dying parent alone
predicaments.basis: Hatidže shares her house with Nazife, 85, partly blind and bedridden and wholly dependent on her, in a village with no power or running water, until she dies.

predicaments.situation: a household is pressed by mouths to feed
predicaments.basis: Hussein arrives with a wife, seven children and imported livestock, needs money, and takes up beekeeping because he watched it feed her.

predicaments.situation: hospitality is answered with ruin
predicaments.basis: Hatidže keeps good relations with the family and plays with the children, and when their animals and hives have wrecked her living they simply move on to another village.

relatives.title: Dersu Uzala
relatives.shares: a life held together by taking only what the land can give back

relatives.title: There Will Be Blood
relatives.shares: a neighbour draws down a shared source until the other has nothing

relatives.title: The Ballad of Narayama
relatives.shares: an aged parent's total dependence on one child in a subsistence place

relatives.title: Amour
relatives.shares: one person alone with the daily care of someone dying

relatives.title: Kes
relatives.shares: a person whose only tenderness goes to creatures, and who loses them

films.title: The Iron Giant
films.engine: A boy finds a crashed machine that eats metal and has no memory of what it is, and hides it from a government man who is certain it must be destroyed. The boy spends the film arguing that what you were built out of does not decide what you are, and the machine settles the argument by flying into a missile aimed at the town that was shooting at it.

predicaments.situation: a made thing refuses its given purpose
predicaments.basis: The Giant's weapons fire automatically when threatened, horrifying him; Hogarth tells him he can choose who to be, and he chooses to intercept the missile instead of fighting.

predicaments.situation: something living is hidden from those hunting it
predicaments.basis: Hogarth shelters the Giant first at his house, then in Dean's scrapyard, where Dean disguises him as a sculpture while soldiers search.

predicaments.situation: a stranger is feared for what he could do
predicaments.basis: Mansley, having seen no violence, insists the Giant is a national threat and brings General Rogard and troops to Rockwell, then calls in a nuclear strike.

predicaments.situation: a people turn against those they once welcomed
predicaments.basis: The townspeople cheer the Giant for catching two falling boys and are firing on him minutes later.

predicaments.situation: a watcher moves into the home he watches
predicaments.basis: Mansley rents a room from Hogarth's widowed mother Annie so he can keep the boy under observation.

predicaments.situation: a child explains dying to another
predicaments.basis: After hunters shoot a deer, Hogarth tries to explain death to the Giant, who is unsettled by it and returns to it at the end.

relatives.title: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial
relatives.shares: a child hides a being from the men who would take it apart

relatives.title: Frankenstein
relatives.shares: a made thing judged entirely by the shape it was given

relatives.title: Blade Runner
relatives.shares: a manufactured being chooses mercy toward the people hunting it

relatives.title: Edward Scissorhands
relatives.shares: a town takes a stranger in and turns on him within days

relatives.title: Grave of the Fireflies
relatives.shares: a child assumes sole guardianship of something that cannot survive the adult world

films.title: The Incredibles
films.engine: A man whose one gift was made illegal after the lawsuits spends fifteen years pretending to be ordinary, and lies to his wife to take a secret job that lets him feel like himself again. The job is bait laid by a boy he brushed off decades earlier, who has spent his life building a way to make people like him unnecessary; the family survives only by stopping the pretence and acting together as what they are.

predicaments.situation: a slight is repaid years later
predicaments.basis: Bob rejected the boy Buddy Pine who wanted to be his sidekick; Buddy becomes Syndrome, lures supers to their deaths against his Omnidroid, and plans to make heroes meaningless.

predicaments.situation: a person is forbidden to be what he is
predicaments.basis: The Superhero Relocation Program bans powers in public, leaving Bob in a claims job he resents, sneaking out at night with Lucius, and his children told to hide what they can do.

predicaments.situation: a man hides his true nature from his family
predicaments.basis: Bob conceals his firing and his Nomanisan missions from Helen, who learns the truth from Edna and finds him by the beacon sewn into the suits.

predicaments.situation: a people turn against those they once welcomed
predicaments.basis: A man Bob saved from suicide sues him, injured train passengers follow, and public feeling flips until the government hides the supers away.

predicaments.situation: a family must act as one to survive
predicaments.basis: Violet's fields free them from Syndrome, Dash and Violet fight off the guards, and all of them plus Lucius bring down the Omnidroid together.

relatives.title: All About Eve
relatives.shares: an adoring admirer, once rebuffed, rebuilds themself into the rival

relatives.title: Amadeus
relatives.shares: a lesser man's whole life organised around a gift he was denied

relatives.title: The Wrestler
relatives.shares: a man who can only feel real doing the one thing he is no longer allowed

relatives.title: Unbreakable
relatives.shares: a devotee engineers catastrophes to force a hero back into being

relatives.title: Tootsie
relatives.shares: a working double life sustained by lying to the person closest

films.title: WALL-E
films.engine: A cleaning machine left running on an abandoned planet has quietly become someone — he keeps things, he is lonely — and he falls for the probe sent to check whether Earth can support life again. Following her onto the ship where humanity has been waited on into helplessness, he becomes the reason a captain finally disobeys a seven-hundred-year-old standing order and takes hold of the controls himself.

predicaments.situation: a made thing refuses its given purpose
predicaments.basis: WALL-E collects instead of compacting, EVE abandons her directive to protect him, and AUTO does the opposite — destroying the plant to keep faith with his orders.

predicaments.situation: an old order outlives the reason for it
predicaments.basis: Directive A113, recorded by the Buy n Large CEO in 2110 when Earth was too toxic, still forbids return centuries after the planet has begun to recover.

predicaments.situation: something living is hidden from those hunting it
predicaments.basis: The seedling is the only proof Earth can live again; GO-4 hides it in a self-destructing pod on AUTO's orders, and WALL-E carries it out through the explosion.

predicaments.situation: people hand over the steering of their lives
predicaments.basis: The Axiom's passengers have grown helpless under robots that serve their every whim while the autopilot flies the ship, until McCrea stands up out of his chair.

predicaments.situation: taking more than can be replaced ruins everyone
predicaments.basis: Rampant consumption and corporate neglect turned Earth into a poisoned waste that had to be evacuated and then abandoned by its own cleanup.

predicaments.situation: a beloved returns emptied of all memory
predicaments.basis: EVE rebuilds WALL-E on Earth and he wakes as a blank compactor with no trace of the personality that loved her, until her touch shocks him back.

relatives.title: Silent Running
relatives.shares: a lone caretaker keeps the last living plants alive after everyone stopped caring

relatives.title: 2001: A Space Odyssey
relatives.shares: a ship's intelligence turns on its people to protect a directive they were never told

relatives.title: Castle in the Sky
relatives.shares: a machine built as a weapon spends its time tending a garden instead

relatives.title: Her
relatives.shares: devotion between a person and something not born, tested by how it is made

relatives.title: Brazil
relatives.shares: a system executing a rule long after the rule stopped meaning anything

films.title: Waltz with Bashir
films.engine: A man realises he remembers nothing of the months he spent as a young soldier in a city where a massacre happened — only one image of swimming at night under falling flares. He goes from friend to friend borrowing their memories until he can place himself: not among the men doing the killing, but in the ring outside firing the flares that lit it for them.

predicaments.situation: a man cannot remember his own part
predicaments.basis: Ari finds he has no recollection of his 1982 deployment beyond a single vision of bathing off Beirut under descending flares, and cannot place it.

predicaments.situation: a man asks others what he himself did
predicaments.basis: On a therapist friend's advice, Ari interviews fellow soldiers, a PTSD specialist and the reporter Ron Ben-Yishai to reconstruct where he was standing.

predicaments.situation: one helps harm along without doing it
predicaments.basis: Ari's unit fired the flares that lit Sabra and Shatila for the Phalange militia carrying out the killings, and he did not know what was happening until it was over.

predicaments.situation: one is given the work others refuse
predicaments.basis: Boaz's unit assigned him the shooting of dogs on night infiltrations because they knew he could not kill a person; twenty-six of them come back nightly.

predicaments.situation: another's confession forces a man to look inward
predicaments.basis: Boaz's account of his recurring dream is what sends Ari, that same night, into the first fragment of his own missing memory.

relatives.title: The Act of Killing
relatives.shares: men reconstruct, in front of a camera, their own participation in a massacre

relatives.title: Rashomon
relatives.shares: an event exists only as the incompatible memories of those who were near it

relatives.title: Hiroshima mon amour
relatives.shares: a person retrieves a buried war memory by telling it to someone else

relatives.title: Come and See
relatives.shares: a young soldier present at atrocity without the standing to stop it

relatives.title: Shoah
relatives.shares: testimony gathered from the ring of people who were adjacent to the killing

films.title: Tár
films.engine: A conductor has spent years turning the people nearest her into extensions of her career — an assistant who runs her life, young musicians whose futures she can open or close, a wife who sits in her own orchestra. The film is what happens when she wants a new one of them badly enough to be careless, and the people she has already used stop absorbing it. Everything she took is taken back, down to the name she was born under.

predicaments.situation: the powerful desire those dependent on them
predicaments.basis: Lydia alters her scorecard in a blind audition to admit the young cellist Olga and programs a concerto that hands her the solo, having earlier mentored and then blacklisted Krista Taylor.

predicaments.situation: one person wants more than the other returns
predicaments.basis: Lydia trails Olga home through a derelict building, falls and injures her face, and tells Sharon she was mugged.

predicaments.situation: loyalty is withdrawn after a promotion is denied
predicaments.basis: Francesca, who has deleted Krista's emails and managed Lydia's private life, is passed over for the assistant conductor post, resigns, and supplies the incriminating correspondence to Krista's parents' lawyers.

predicaments.situation: private conduct is exposed to public judgment
predicaments.basis: A manipulatively edited video of her Juilliard masterclass goes viral, a New York Post article accuses her of predation, her Wikipedia page is rewritten, and protestors meet her at the deposition.

predicaments.situation: the one lifted up is later destroyed
predicaments.basis: Krista Taylor, whom Lydia once mentored through the Accordion Foundation, is blacklisted after their falling-out and kills herself.

relatives.title: All About Eve
relatives.shares: the indispensable assistant who is denied her step up and turns the principal's own archive against her

relatives.title: The Assistant
relatives.shares: the machinery by which a powerful figure's appetites are administered by the subordinate who books the rooms

relatives.title: The Piano Teacher
relatives.shares: a musician whose authority over a student's future and whose desire for them run through the same channel

relatives.title: A Hero
relatives.shares: a life dismantled by a circulating video and an edited public record rather than by any verdict

relatives.title: Whiplash
relatives.shares: a young player's career held entirely in the hands of the person who decides who is promising

films.title: Certain Women
films.engine: Four women in one stretch of Montana each need something from another person — to be believed, to be let off, to be wanted back — and each runs into the plain fact that what they say does not carry the weight it needs to. Nobody is cruel and nothing is resolved; the film is about how ordinary the failure is and how everyone gets up the next morning anyway.

predicaments.situation: the same words count only from a man
predicaments.basis: Fuller ignores eight months of Laura's advice but accepts it instantly from the second lawyer she takes him to, and Albert talks only to Ryan while Gina is the one asking for the sandstone.

predicaments.situation: someone signs away more than they knew
predicaments.basis: Fuller accepted his employer's small early settlement for a disabling workplace injury and thereby lost forever the right to sue a company that was clearly at fault.

predicaments.situation: the only helper hands the person over
predicaments.basis: Fuller releases his hostage and asks Laura to stall the police at the front while he slips out the back; she walks out and tells them exactly where he is.

predicaments.situation: one person wants more than the other returns
predicaments.basis: Jamie keeps attending a night class she has no use for, drives four hours to find Beth in a parking lot and says she came because otherwise she would never see her again; Beth says nothing.

predicaments.situation: something is taken from the barely willing
predicaments.basis: Gina secretly records an unfocused elderly neighbour tentatively agreeing to let them have the sandstone from his yard, and when they come to load the truck he will not wave back.

predicaments.situation: one partner is undermined before the child
predicaments.basis: Gina feels Ryan constantly cuts her authority with their teenage daughter and gives her no support in the negotiation, until he finally praises her work at the barbecue.

relatives.title: Dog Day Afternoon
relatives.shares: a man with a genuine grievance takes a hostage and is talked down by the one person still treating him as a person

relatives.title: The Rider
relatives.shares: a working life ended by an injury the body will not take back, in the same emptied Western country

relatives.title: Frances Ha
relatives.shares: one friend needing the other far more than she is needed, and driving across a country to say so

relatives.title: Make Way for Tomorrow
relatives.shares: property quietly extracted from an old person no longer able to hold onto it

relatives.title: Wanda
relatives.shares: a woman whose account of her own situation is never quite credited by anyone she gives it to

films.title: Intolerable Cruelty
films.engine: A divorce lawyer who has grown rich proving what marriages are actually worth meets a woman who marries in order to be paid to leave. Each sets out to take the other, and the film's joke is that the only proof either can offer of sincerity is to hand over the weapon — sign the document that leaves you with nothing, or tear it up in front of the person most likely to use it.

predicaments.situation: a trap is sprung on its own maker
predicaments.basis: Miles, inventor of the unbreakable Massey pre-nup, marries Marylin on impulse, signs one himself to prove disinterest, and then discovers her millionaire husband was a hired soap actor and his own fortune is exposed.

predicaments.situation: two people court each other as opponents
predicaments.basis: Miles and Marylin flirt over dinner mid-settlement while he has her address book copied, and she later hires Donaly to build the fake husband that will ruin him.

predicaments.situation: private conduct is exposed to public judgment
predicaments.basis: Gus Petch videotapes Rex's motel tryst for his wife, and in court Puffy testifies that Marylin had him pick out a rich philandering fool she could divorce.

predicaments.situation: someone signs away more than they knew
predicaments.basis: Donaly is left broke by the settlement Miles wins against him, and the Massey pre-nup is written so that whoever signs it can never claim anything.

predicaments.situation: a ruined person is enlisted for revenge
predicaments.basis: Marylin finds Donaly homeless on the street clutching his Emmy and offers him his career back in exchange for the actor who will play Howard D. Doyle.

predicaments.situation: each pays to have the other killed
predicaments.basis: Herb Myerson puts Miles onto the hitman Wheezy Joe, Marylin offers Joe double to turn on Miles instead, and Joe shoots himself mistaking his gun for his inhaler.

relatives.title: The Lady Eve
relatives.shares: a professional predator and her mark fall for each other in the middle of the swindle

relatives.title: His Girl Friday
relatives.shares: two divorced adversaries who can only conduct a courtship as a contest

relatives.title: Trouble in Paradise
relatives.shares: two people whose trade is taking money off others, testing whether either will stop short with the other

relatives.title: The Palm Beach Story
relatives.shares: marriage handled openly as a financial instrument by everyone in the room

relatives.title: The Awful Truth
relatives.shares: a couple who dismantle each other legally and discover that was the courtship

films.title: The Tragedy of Macbeth
films.engine: Two people are told what is going to happen to them and decide to help it along. He murders the king who is sleeping as a guest under his own roof, and every killing after that is meant to close the gap the last one opened — the child who must not survive, the rival who must not be warned, the household of the man who left. The marriage strong enough to plan the first murder cannot hold either of them through the rest.

predicaments.situation: being told the future makes it come true
predicaments.basis: Three witches hail Macbeth as Cawdor and future king and promise Banquo a line of kings; each thing he does to secure or prevent a prophecy is what fulfils it, down to the wood that walks and the man not born of woman.

predicaments.situation: loyalty is withdrawn after a promotion is denied
predicaments.basis: Duncan rewards Macbeth with Cawdor's title but names his own son Malcolm prince of Cumberland, which Macbeth reads as the obstacle standing between him and the throne.

predicaments.situation: one talks the other into an irreversible act
predicaments.basis: Lady Macbeth, knowing the prophecies, drugs the king's grooms and pushes her hesitating husband through the murder; she later loses her mind over it and dies before he does.

predicaments.situation: a guest is killed by his own host
predicaments.basis: Duncan spends the night at Macbeth's castle and is stabbed in his bed, after which Macbeth executes the drugged servants as the supposed traitors.

predicaments.situation: a family is punished for one man's escape
predicaments.basis: Macduff having already fled to England, Macbeth orders his entire household slaughtered, and Ross carries the news to the widowed father who then hunts him.

predicaments.situation: the go-between quietly decides everyone's fate
predicaments.basis: Ross executes Cawdor, rides as the third murderer, chases Fleance, brings Macduff word of the killings, is implied to kill Lady Macbeth, and finally spirits the surviving boy out of Scotland.

relatives.title: Throne of Blood
relatives.shares: a soldier told he will rule, whose wife converts the prediction into a murder under his own roof

relatives.title: Ran
relatives.shares: a ruler's naming of his heir detonating the loyalty of those who expected to be named

relatives.title: Oedipus Rex
relatives.shares: a prophecy that is fulfilled precisely by the steps taken to escape it

relatives.title: Double Indemnity
relatives.shares: one partner steadily talking the other across the line into a killing neither can live inside afterwards

relatives.title: A Simple Plan
relatives.shares: each further crime committed only to seal the last one, until nothing is left of the pair who started

films.title: Lincoln
films.engine: A president has a narrow window in which a constitutional amendment can be passed, and every vote he still needs belongs to a man who wants something for it — a job, a peace conference, a principle stated more softly than it is held. The film is the running tally of what he pays: bribes, an evasive sentence to the House, a war he could have ended weeks earlier, all to make one change permanent before the returning states can undo it.

predicaments.situation: a good end is pursued by dishonest means
predicaments.basis: Lincoln has agents dangle federal jobs at defeated lame-duck Democrats and issues a carefully worded denial that Confederate envoys are in Washington, and the amendment passes by two votes.

predicaments.situation: help is bought with a concession one hates
predicaments.basis: Blair will deliver the conservative faction only if Lincoln authorizes him to open peace talks with Richmond, which is exactly what could sink the vote and enrage the Radicals.

predicaments.situation: someone must claim less than they believe
predicaments.basis: Thaddeus Stevens, who holds for actual racial equality, tells the House floor the amendment means only equality before the law, and goes home afterwards to Lydia Hamilton Smith.

predicaments.situation: the ending of a fight is deliberately delayed
predicaments.basis: The Confederate envoys are kept waiting outside Washington until the vote is taken, and Lincoln then tells them slavery cannot be restored, so the talks collapse and the fighting runs on to Appomattox.

predicaments.situation: a father must let his son risk death
predicaments.basis: Robert quits law school to enlist for a standing of his own, his mother begs against it, and Lincoln reluctantly arranges his commission.

relatives.title: A Man for All Seasons
relatives.shares: a man of conviction who must say publicly far less than he holds in order to survive the vote

relatives.title: The Battle of Algiers
relatives.shares: an end held to be worth the specific dishonest means counted out on screen

relatives.title: Amazing Grace
relatives.shares: an abolition carried by head-counting, horse-trading and timing rather than by argument

relatives.title: Ivan's Childhood
relatives.shares: a young man who insists on the war his elders would keep him out of

relatives.title: Z
relatives.shares: a political outcome decided by who can be bought, delayed or kept out of the room at the right hour

films.title: The Terminal
films.engine: A man lands in a country that has stopped recognising his own while he was in the air, so he can neither be admitted nor sent home, and the official responsible would rather make him someone else's problem than solve him. He builds a life in the waiting area, becomes useful to the people who work there, and the errand he actually came for — an autograph his father died one short of — sits a few miles outside a door he is not allowed through.

predicaments.situation: a man is allowed neither forward nor back
predicaments.basis: A coup in Krakozhia voids Viktor Navorski's passport mid-flight, so U.S. Customs will not let him into New York and cannot send him back, stranding him in the JFK transit lounge for nine months.

predicaments.situation: the dead leave an errand for the living
predicaments.basis: Viktor's late father spent his life collecting the autographs of the 57 musicians in a jazz photograph and died needing only Benny Golson's, which is the reason his son came to New York carrying a peanut can.

predicaments.situation: a man is coerced through threats to friends
predicaments.basis: Dixon tells Viktor that if he does not board a plane home he will prosecute the janitor, the baggage handler and the others for the illegal work and favours that kept Viktor alive in the terminal.

predicaments.situation: the beloved is already promised to another
predicaments.basis: Amelia is entangled with a married government official, and after using him to obtain Viktor's one-day emergency visa she tells Viktor she has gone back to the man.

predicaments.situation: authority is defied by someone with nothing
predicaments.basis: Viktor helps a desperate traveller get medicine past Dixon's paperwork objection in front of Dixon's superiors, and at the end the officers ordered to stop him at the exit stand aside instead.

relatives.title: Casablanca
relatives.shares: people penned in a place of transit, unable to go forward or home

relatives.title: Le Havre
relatives.shares: the small workers of a place shelter a man the state will not admit

relatives.title: The Trial (1962)
relatives.shares: a man bound by an administrative decision no one will explain or reverse

relatives.title: In This World
relatives.shares: a border refuses a man both entry and return

relatives.title: Cast Away
relatives.shares: a life improvised inside enforced waiting until the waiting ends

films.title: Honey Don't!
films.engine: An investigator takes up the death of a woman who phoned her frightened and was killed before they could meet, and the trail runs into a temple whose preacher beds his congregants and moves drugs. What she is really walking toward is closer in: her teenage niece goes missing, and the policewoman she has been sleeping with turns out to be the one killing girls and holding the niece in her basement.

predicaments.situation: the dead leave an errand for the living
predicaments.basis: Mia Novotny called Honey afraid and unable to go to the police, then was stabbed and staged in a wrecked car before their meeting, leaving Honey the only person asking why.

predicaments.situation: the danger is discovered to be the lover
predicaments.basis: MG, the policewoman Honey met at the station and took home, is the killer of Mia and others, and Honey finds Corinne's lipstick on a teacup in her house before MG stabs her.

predicaments.situation: the one trusted for shelter is the predator
predicaments.basis: Reverend Drew Devlin preaches submission to young women at the Four-Way Temple, takes them to bed as "fellowship", and runs a murderous narcotics operation behind it.

predicaments.situation: a missing girl is searched for by kin
predicaments.basis: Corinne does not come home after her shift, and Heidi calls her sister Honey, who drives the town fearing the girl is going the way Mia went.

predicaments.situation: an absent parent asks to be forgiven
predicaments.basis: The old man Corinne fled at the bus stop turns out to be Honey and Heidi's estranged father, who approaches Honey wanting to reconnect.

predicaments.situation: a suitor cannot hear a refusal
predicaments.basis: Marty Metakawich asks Honey out at the crash site and again in the ambulance, treating her answer that she likes girls as a joke both times.

relatives.title: The Night of the Hunter
relatives.shares: a preacher who feeds on the people who trust him with their souls

relatives.title: Shadow of a Doubt
relatives.shares: the killer is the intimate already inside the family's affections

relatives.title: The Long Goodbye
relatives.shares: a death the investigator takes personally because the dead person called first

relatives.title: Chinatown
relatives.shares: a case that keeps leading back to rot inside the investigator's own reach

relatives.title: The Vanishing (1988)
relatives.shares: a young woman disappears and someone refuses to stop looking

films.title: Eastern Promises
films.engine: A midwife delivers the baby of a fourteen-year-old who dies in childbirth, and her attempt to find the child a family walks her into the household that destroyed the mother. Inside that household a father is trying to force his disappointing son into fitness to inherit, a driver who kills and cleans for them is not what anyone there thinks, and the newborn is living evidence that the old man wants erased.

predicaments.situation: the dead leave an errand for the living
predicaments.basis: Tatiana dies leaving a diary in Russian and a daughter, and Anna Khitrova sets out to trace the girl's family rather than let the baby go into foster care.

predicaments.situation: the one trusted for shelter is the predator
predicaments.basis: Semyon presents himself as a kind restaurateur who offers to translate the diary, while the diary records that he raped Tatiana to demonstrate to his son how to break her.

predicaments.situation: someone becomes what he was sent to destroy
predicaments.basis: Nikolai rises from driver and body-disposer to full member with star tattoos while secretly working as an FSB agent, and ends by taking over the organisation himself.

predicaments.situation: a son is ordered to kill his own kin
predicaments.basis: Semyon sends Kirill to drown the newborn who is both his father's child and his own half-sister, and Kirill is found weeping with her by the Thames.

predicaments.situation: a child is given away to be raised
predicaments.basis: Tatiana's daughter, unclaimed by any traceable family and marked for death by her own father, is adopted by Anna and named Christine.

predicaments.situation: the keeper of a secret is quietly threatened
predicaments.basis: Semyon appears unannounced in Anna's restricted hospital ward once he knows she has read the diary, and she surrenders it; her uncle Stepan, who translated it, then disappears.

relatives.title: Infernal Affairs
relatives.shares: a man embedded so deep in the organisation that the cover becomes the life

relatives.title: A Prophet
relatives.shares: an outsider climbing a criminal hierarchy by making himself indispensable to its head

relatives.title: The Godfather
relatives.shares: a father forcing a son toward the cruelty required to inherit him

relatives.title: Sansho the Bailiff
relatives.shares: the hospitable stranger who turns out to trade in the people in his care

relatives.title: Shoplifters
relatives.shares: a child claimed outside the law by whoever will actually keep her

films.title: From Up on Poppy Hill
films.engine: A girl who runs a boarding house raises signal flags every morning for a father lost at sea, and the boy who has been reading them from a tugboat becomes the person she wants; then they are shown the same photograph and told they share that father. Around them the students fight to save a condemned clubhouse, and both questions turn out to hang on what the adults did with the wreckage of the war and never explained to the children born out of it.

predicaments.situation: lovers are told they share a parent
predicaments.basis: Umi and Shun each own a copy of a photograph of three young naval men, and Shun's adoptive father's account leads them to believe Yūichirō Sawamura fathered them both.

predicaments.situation: the dead leave an errand for the living
predicaments.basis: Umi hoists "I pray for safe voyages" each morning for her father, killed on a supply ship in the Korean War, and Onodera, the last of the three men alive, finally tells the children what happened to all of them.

predicaments.situation: the young fight to keep an old place
predicaments.basis: The Latin Quarter, the decaying building housing Konan Academy's clubs, is slated for demolition until the students clean and renovate it and take their case to the school board's chairman in Tokyo.

predicaments.situation: a child is given away to be raised
predicaments.basis: Orphaned at birth in 1945, Shun was registered as Yūichirō's son and then handed to the Kazamas, who had just lost a newborn of their own.

predicaments.situation: a birth is hidden from the one born
predicaments.basis: Only when Ryoko returns from the United States does anyone tell Shun that his father was Hiroshi Tachibana, killed on a repatriation ship, and his mother died bearing him.

relatives.title: Oldboy
relatives.shares: two people in love confronted with a claim of blood kinship between them

relatives.title: Like Father, Like Son
relatives.shares: a paternity discovered late that forces a family to decide what a parent is

relatives.title: Secrets & Lies
relatives.shares: the truth of a birth kept from the person it belongs to

relatives.title: Cinema Paradiso
relatives.shares: a shabby building holding a community's memory, marked for demolition

films.title: My Best Fiend
films.engine: A director goes back over five films made with an actor he once shared an apartment with, fought physically with, and threatened to shoot on location — now that the man is dead and cannot answer back. Women who acted opposite the same man describe someone far calmer than the one he remembers, so the account has to hold both the figure screaming at an audience and the one playing with a butterfly in the jungle.

predicaments.situation: two people cannot work together nor apart
predicaments.basis: Herzog and Klaus Kinski made Aguirre, Nosferatu, Woyzeck, Fitzcarraldo and Cobra Verde together across two decades despite altercations violent enough to be documented on the sets.

predicaments.situation: a collaboration is held together by threats
predicaments.basis: Herzog retells the story of threatening to shoot Kinski if he walked off the Aguirre production, and returns to the footage of Fitzcarraldo, the shoot that strained them most.

predicaments.situation: the same person is remembered differently by each
predicaments.basis: Eva Mattes and Claudia Cardinale, who played opposite Kinski, describe a calm side that sits against Herzog's own memories and the opening footage of him cursing an audience.

predicaments.situation: the dead are spoken for by the survivor
predicaments.basis: Herzog narrates Kinski's death as the consequence of living too strenuously, calls him "like a comet", and gives him the last image, collapsing in the surf at the end of Cobra Verde.

relatives.title: Amadeus
relatives.shares: a survivor narrating a dead man he both revered and could not stop fighting

relatives.title: Citizen Kane
relatives.shares: a man assembled out of the contradictory accounts of those who knew him

relatives.title: Rashomon
relatives.shares: the same person and events remembered irreconcilably by each witness

relatives.title: Hearts of Darkness: A Filmmaker's Apocalypse
relatives.shares: a production that consumed the people making it and became the story

relatives.title: Burden of Dreams
relatives.shares: the same shoot seen as an ordeal binding director and actor together

films.title: Encounters at the End of the World
films.engine: A filmmaker goes to the bottom of the world explicitly not for the animals but for the people who ended up there, and asks each of them what brought them to a place with no ordinary life in it. The question sharpens against a penguin that leaves its colony and walks inland toward certain death for no reason anyone can supply, and against the trinkets people bury in tunnels under the ice for whoever comes next.

predicaments.situation: people with no place left gather together
predicaments.basis: At McMurdo Station Herzog and Zeitlinger interview maintenance workers, divers, a philosopher who mops floors, and scientists whose dreams, rather than their research, the film says it is after.

predicaments.situation: things are left for people not yet born
predicaments.basis: Shackleton's cabin stands unchanged after a century, and in ice tunnels beneath the South Pole station people have set caviar, a frozen sturgeon and small mementos into carved shelves, while Herzog imagines alien scientists reading a post-human Earth.

predicaments.situation: one walks away from the group toward death
predicaments.basis: After Herzog questions the penguin scientist about disorientation in the colonies, the film follows a single penguin that turns from both the sea and its group and heads for the continental interior.

relatives.title: Into the Wild
relatives.shares: someone who turns away from the group and keeps walking into country that will kill him

relatives.title: Grizzly Man
relatives.shares: people who choose a place with no ordinary life in it and explain themselves badly

relatives.title: Sans Soleil
relatives.shares: a record assembled of a world for whoever might read it afterward
