relatives.title: Dersu Uzala
relatives.shares: lives lived at the habitable edge, described by an outsider passing through

films.title: Little Dieter Needs to Fly
films.engine: A boy watches the aircraft that flatten his village and decides he wants to be the man flying one; he gets there, is shot down over Laos, starved and chained in a jungle camp, and gets himself out. Decades later he agrees to walk the same jungle again with hired locals playing his captors, narrating as he goes. The film is a man consenting to be turned back into the person that was done to him, with someone watching.

predicaments.situation: a survivor is made to re-enact his ordeal
predicaments.basis: Herzog takes Dengler back to Laos and Thailand thirty years on, hires local men to play his captors, and has him retrace the steps of his capture and escape while describing them.

predicaments.situation: a child wants to become what destroyed him
predicaments.basis: Dengler's earliest memory is of Allied fighter-bombers wrecking his village, and he says he decided to become a pilot after watching one of them fly past his house.

predicaments.situation: a captive escapes those holding him
predicaments.basis: After torture and starvation handcuffed to six other prisoners in a bamboo camp run by the Pathet Lao and then North Vietnamese soldiers, Dengler breaks out and is eventually spotted from the air by another American pilot.

predicaments.situation: two men find their childhoods were the same
predicaments.basis: Herzog frames Dengler as a kindred spirit because both grew up hungry in a Germany reduced to rubble, and Dengler's accounts of postwar deprivation echo Herzog's own.

relatives.title: The Act of Killing
relatives.shares: men are brought back to the scene of the worst thing that happened and asked to perform it for a camera

relatives.title: S21: The Khmer Rouge Killing Machine
relatives.shares: survivor and former guards re-enact the routines of a prison inside the emptied prison itself

relatives.title: Shoah
relatives.shares: a witness is returned to the ground where it happened and made to speak while standing on it

relatives.title: Le Trou
relatives.shares: men held in confinement work their way out by patience and nerve

relatives.title: Hiroshima mon amour
relatives.shares: two people recognise each other through matching wartime childhoods on opposite sides

films.title: Into the Abyss
films.engine: Two nineteen-year-olds killed a woman and two boys to take their cars, and one of them is eight days from being put to death when the camera reaches him. The film sits with everyone still standing around the killing — the daughter and brother of the dead, the imprisoned father whose plea kept his son alive, the woman carrying that son's child, the men who worked the execution chamber — and watches what the state's answer costs the people asked to be part of it.

predicaments.situation: a killing is answered with another killing
predicaments.basis: Michael Perry is executed on 1 July 2010 for the murders of Sandra Stotler, her grandson Adam and Adam's friend Jeremy, while the interviewer states plainly that he opposes the death penalty.

predicaments.situation: a parent pleads for the child he abandoned
predicaments.basis: Jason Burkett's father, locked up for most of Jason's life and now held in the same facility as his son, makes an emotional appeal that helps get Jason a life sentence instead of death.

predicaments.situation: the accused denies it to the very end
predicaments.basis: Both Perry and Burkett deny any involvement in the three murders, Perry doing so days before his execution, despite the confession that led police to the bodies.

predicaments.situation: someone blames himself for introducing two people
predicaments.basis: Jeremy Richardson's brother says he feels guilty because he was the one who introduced Jeremy to the men who killed him.

predicaments.situation: a woman binds herself to a condemned man
predicaments.basis: Jason Burkett's wife met him while he was already imprisoned, married him, and has become pregnant with his child.

predicaments.situation: a man refuses to keep doing his duty
predicaments.basis: A former death house worker walked away from the job after taking part in the execution of Karla Faye Tucker, having assisted at many before it.

relatives.title: A Short Film About Killing
relatives.shares: a squalid murder set directly against the state's own methodical killing of the murderer

relatives.title: Dead Man Walking
relatives.shares: someone sits with a condemned man in his final days while the families of the dead wait outside

relatives.title: The Thin Blue Line
relatives.shares: a confession, a death sentence, and men who go on denying it

relatives.title: In Cold Blood
relatives.shares: two young men kill a household for almost nothing and are hanged for it

relatives.title: Capote
relatives.shares: an interviewer builds a relationship with a condemned man knowing the execution date is the ending

films.title: Doubt
films.engine: A school principal becomes convinced a priest is doing something to a boy and has nothing but her conviction; lacking proof, she invents a phone call and uses his reaction as evidence. The boy's mother, who cannot protect him from his own father, would rather he keep the priest's protection than have anyone be right. The film runs on what a person will become in order to act on a certainty she cannot support.

predicaments.situation: someone acts on certainty without any proof
predicaments.basis: Sister Aloysius admits to Father Flynn that all she has is her certainty about his conduct with Donald Miller, and moves to force him out anyway.

predicaments.situation: the accused denies it to the very end
predicaments.basis: Flynn explains the rectory meeting as covering up Donald's drinking of sacramental wine, declares his innocence to the last, and requests a transfer while still maintaining he did nothing wrong.

predicaments.situation: a parent chooses between two harms
predicaments.basis: Mrs. Miller tells Aloysius that her son is gay, that his father would beat him for it, and that the priest is the only man who has been kind to him — so she asks that Flynn be removed rather than Donald, and above all that Donald reach June with good marks.

predicaments.situation: a lie is used to extract a confession
predicaments.basis: Aloysius claims she contacted a nun from Flynn's previous parish and found a history of infringements; she later tells Sister James she invented it, reasoning that a false story would not have worked on an innocent man.

predicaments.situation: someone below moves against someone above
predicaments.basis: Aloysius, a principal answerable to the clergy, threatens a priest with exposure and says she will do whatever it takes even if she is thrown out of the church herself; he in turn threatens her position and accuses her of insubordination.

relatives.title: The Hunt
relatives.shares: a man is destroyed by a suspicion about a child that no one can prove or disprove

relatives.title: The Crucible
relatives.shares: certainty operating as evidence, and a lie deployed to smoke out a truth

relatives.title: The Children's Hour
relatives.shares: an unproven accusation about conduct ruins the accused regardless of what happened

relatives.title: Le Corbeau
relatives.shares: a community's suspicion runs ahead of any proof and everyone is implicated by acting on it

relatives.title: Anatomy of a Fall
relatives.shares: the film withholds the fact and leaves only the competing certainties of the people around it

films.title: Song to Song
films.engine: A woman sleeps with the man who can build her a career and then falls in love with someone who doesn't know about it, and carries the concealment for as long as she can. When she is finally asked outright and answers — badly, revising the details as she goes — the answering costs her the person she wanted. Beside her, another woman is lifted out of poverty by the same man and cannot survive the life he buys her.

predicaments.situation: a secret is kept from the one loved
predicaments.basis: Faye and Cook hide their affair from BV through a shared trip to Mexico and beyond, even after Cook suggests she tell him.

predicaments.situation: a person trades intimacy for advancement
predicaments.basis: Faye, a guitarist looking for a way up, begins the affair with the record producer Cook believing it can help her career, and he later offers to produce her.

predicaments.situation: confession ends what concealment protected
predicaments.basis: BV asks Faye point blank whether she slept with Cook; she says yes, then changes the account from once to several times, and he breaks off the relationship.

predicaments.situation: one partner keeps what both of them made
predicaments.basis: BV discovers that the copyrights on their work are all in Cook's name and confronts him over splitting profits on work BV does, ending both the business and the friendship.

predicaments.situation: someone is lifted out of need by another
predicaments.basis: Cook courts Rhonda, a former kindergarten teacher waiting tables, marries her and pays to build her mother Miranda a house; she then cannot bear his drugs and other women and takes her own life.

relatives.title: Contempt
relatives.shares: a woman's dealings with the man holding the money poison what she has with the man she lives with

relatives.title: A Star Is Born
relatives.shares: intimacy and career advancement run through the same person and cannot be separated

relatives.title: Faithless
relatives.shares: an affair concealed, then confessed under direct questioning, and the confession is what destroys the couple

relatives.title: La Notte
relatives.shares: people who move constantly between each other trying to feel something and finding nothing lands

relatives.title: An Education
relatives.shares: someone accepts being lifted into a better life by a man whose terms only become visible later

films.title: Dolls
films.engine: Three people are stranded on the far side of a choice they cannot take back: a man who dropped his fiancée to marry his employer's daughter and then, after she tries to kill herself and comes back empty, takes her out of the hospital and leads her through the seasons on a cord; a young man who blinds himself so his idol's ruined face will not have to be seen; an old man going back for the woman he left in his youth. Each is trying to stand beside a person he can no longer reach.

predicaments.situation: a person trades intimacy for advancement
predicaments.basis: Matsumoto breaks his engagement to Sawako in order to marry the daughter of his company's president.

predicaments.situation: an abandoned person tries to end her life
predicaments.basis: Sawako attempts suicide after the engagement is broken and survives in a semi-catatonic state.

predicaments.situation: someone spends his life undoing one choice
predicaments.basis: Matsumoto takes Sawako out of the hospital and the two of them wander away together, tied by a red rope, across a full turn of the seasons.

predicaments.situation: one is tied to a person beyond reach
predicaments.basis: Sawako, semi-catatonic, is physically joined to Matsumoto by a red cord for most of the film and cannot answer what he is doing for her.

predicaments.situation: an admirer damages himself to stay loyal
predicaments.basis: Nukui, obsessed with the pop singer Haruna, blinds himself after a car accident disfigures her.

predicaments.situation: someone returns to a love left long ago
predicaments.basis: Hiro, an aged yakuza, sets out to meet again the woman he was with in his youth.

relatives.title: Ugetsu
relatives.shares: a man leaves the woman bound to him for advancement and spends the rest of the film trying to get back to her

relatives.title: Amour
relatives.shares: one person tied to another who has gone past answering, and keeps leading them anyway

relatives.title: Wild Strawberries
relatives.shares: an old man travels back toward the love he walked away from in youth

relatives.title: Vertigo
relatives.shares: a man devotes himself to a woman who cannot be reached as a person, only carried

relatives.title: Perfect Blue
relatives.shares: a follower's whole self is staked on a performer's image and comes apart when the image does

films.title: Dinner with Friends
films.engine: One couple announces their marriage is over, and the couple who introduced them discovers their own life was leaning on that marriage. The friends are pulled into taking sides before either side has been heard, and each conversation afterward turns up something — a years-old affair, a decade of performed contentment — that makes the friendship less survivable than the marriage was.

predicaments.situation: one leaves a marriage for someone new
predicaments.basis: Tom leaves Beth for Nancy, a travel agent, saying he feels unloved and that Beth refuses any intimacy; Beth tells it as a man who only ever wanted sex from her.

predicaments.situation: friends are made to take sides
predicaments.basis: Beth breaks the news alone at Gabe and Karen's dinner before the couple can tell them together, and Karen declares Tom is no longer her friend while Gabe keeps hearing him out.

predicaments.situation: someone is condemned before being heard
predicaments.basis: Tom drives over to give his account and Karen refuses to listen, saying the case is clear cut; Gabe feeds him and asks him to explain.

predicaments.situation: someone learns how easily they would be discarded
predicaments.basis: Gabe takes offence on hearing that Karen would write him off and throw him out on the spot if he ever did what Tom did.

predicaments.situation: a secret is kept from the one loved
predicaments.basis: Tom reveals in parting that Beth and David had an affair much earlier in the marriage, which Beth never told Karen either, reversing Karen's whole reading of the divorce.

predicaments.situation: someone reveals the happiness they showed was false
predicaments.basis: Tom tells Gabe he was unhappy for the whole marriage and had been putting on a show so as not to cause trouble, which Gabe takes as a verdict on the shared life the four of them built.

relatives.title: Husbands and Wives
relatives.shares: one couple's separation forces the friends who introduced them to examine a marriage they thought was safe

relatives.title: Scenes from a Marriage
relatives.shares: a marriage taken apart in conversation, each party giving an account the other does not recognise

relatives.title: The Big Chill
relatives.shares: old friends discover the shared life they believed in was carried by people who had quietly stopped believing

relatives.title: Force Majeure
relatives.shares: a couple's crisis is litigated in front of friends who are dragged into adjudicating it

relatives.title: Another Year
relatives.shares: a settled couple's steadiness is measured against a friend whose life has come apart, and the friendship cannot hold the difference

films.title: The Man from London
films.engine: A man who watches the docks at night from a tower sees a killing, and quietly takes the money the dead man was carrying. From that moment every ordinary thing in his life — his daughter's work, his wife's accounting of the household, a drink with a stranger in a bar — becomes something he has to manage around a thing he cannot say, and the keeping of it costs a second man his life before anyone comes looking for the money.

predicaments.situation: a witness keeps silent about what he saw
predicaments.basis: Maloin sees the dockside fight from his signal tower, retrieves the fallen briefcase of English banknotes, and tells no one — not the police, not his wife, not his daughter.

predicaments.situation: a windfall cannot be spent without exposure
predicaments.basis: The £55,000 in soaked notes is useless to a pointsman whose family has almost no savings; the one purchase he makes with it, an expensive mink stole for Henriette, is instantly inexplicable to his wife.

predicaments.situation: a parent decides a child's life for her
predicaments.basis: Offended at finding Henriette washing the butcher's floor, Maloin hauls her out of the shop against her will and over her employer's protests, then buys her a stole she did not ask for and refuses a drink beside.

predicaments.situation: a killing is excused by those in authority
predicaments.basis: Maloin hands over the briefcase and asks to be arrested for killing Brown in the seaside hut; Morrison instead calls it self-defence, gives him an envelope of the recovered money, and tells him to go home and forget it.

predicaments.situation: a death is settled with a payment
predicaments.basis: Morrison prepares a second envelope of banknotes for Brown's widow, apologises, wishes her well, and leaves her with it while the camera holds on her face.

relatives.title: A Simple Plan
relatives.shares: a witness keeps silent about what he saw and about the money he took from it

relatives.title: The Treasure of the Sierra Madre
relatives.shares: found wealth that cannot be spent without exposing how it was got

relatives.title: L'Argent
relatives.shares: money passing quietly between hands and leaving a killing behind it

relatives.title: Shallow Grave
relatives.shares: a windfall taken in silence that turns a household against itself

films.title: Okja
films.engine: A girl has spent ten years raising an animal she believes is hers and discovers it was always the property of the company that bred it and has come to collect it. Chasing it across two continents, she finds that everyone who touches the animal — the corporation, the activists who free it, even the translator who speaks for her — wants to use it for something larger than the animal itself, and in the end she gets it back the only way the company understands, by paying.

predicaments.situation: a loved one is taken away by strangers
predicaments.basis: Dr. Johnny Wilcox arrives at the mountain farm, declares Okja the best super pig, and has her trucked to Seoul and on to New York while Mija chases the truck on foot.

predicaments.situation: a parent decides a child's life for her
predicaments.basis: Mija's grandfather has known all along that Okja would be taken, and hands her a solid gold pig figurine he saved for as a replacement rather than telling her or contesting it.

predicaments.situation: someone entrusted to speak for another lies
predicaments.basis: K, brought in to translate for Mija, tells the ALF she consents to letting Okja be recaptured with a recording device when she has in fact asked to be taken home.

predicaments.situation: rescuers act for a cause over the rescued
predicaments.basis: Jay's ALF frees Okja only to send her back into Mirando's hands as a camera, and later Jay tries to strike the blinded, panicking animal to protect Mija — Mija stops him and calms Okja herself.

predicaments.situation: a life is bought back for a price
predicaments.basis: At the slaughterhouse ramp Mija offers Nancy the gold pig for Okja, and Nancy takes the trade because she judges it a sound piece of business.

relatives.title: Au Hasard Balthazar
relatives.shares: a creature passed between owners who each want it for their own ends

relatives.title: White God
relatives.shares: a loved animal taken from a girl by strangers acting under authority

relatives.title: Kes
relatives.shares: a child's bond with an animal broken by adults who see only its use

relatives.title: All the Money in the World
relatives.shares: a life bought back for a price by someone who must persuade the holder it is good business

films.title: Pina
films.engine: A company keeps performing the pieces of the woman who made them, rehearsed with her and filmed in the weeks after her death, with each dancer stopping to say one small thing about her. The pieces they perform keep staging the same handful of encounters: a group that picks one of its own out to be destroyed, a sleepwalker whose path is cleared by someone she never sees, a body moved by another person's hands, and a room of people presenting themselves at a dance — the last of these given, unchanged, to teenagers, to the middle-aged and to the old.

predicaments.situation: one is chosen by the group to die
predicaments.basis: In Le sacre du printemps the dancers are split into men and women on a stage laid with peat, and one of the women is selected for sacrifice.

predicaments.situation: those left behind continue another's unfinished work
predicaments.basis: Bausch rehearsed the four pieces with Tanztheater Wuppertal for the filming and died before it; the dancers perform them anyway, and speak about her in voice-over between the excerpts.

predicaments.situation: one person moves another's body for them
predicaments.basis: In Café Müller one man steers the actions of the sleepwalking man and one of the women, while another rushes ahead pulling chairs out of the sleepwalkers' path and a third woman hovers, unable to place herself in it.

predicaments.situation: people display themselves hoping to be chosen
predicaments.basis: In Kontakthof the performers preen and approach one another at a dance in an auditorium, the identical choreography given to the company, to citizens over 65, and to teenagers over 14, with the film cutting between the three.

relatives.title: Midsommar
relatives.shares: a group that selects one of its own to be given up

relatives.title: The Wicker Man
relatives.shares: a community choosing a single person for sacrifice as ritual

relatives.title: Shall We Dance? (1996)
relatives.shares: a hall of people presenting themselves and waiting to be picked

films.title: All the Money in the World
films.engine: A sixteen-year-old is taken off a street in Rome and held for a sum that exactly one man in his family could pay without noticing, and that man treats paying as a precedent that would cost him more than the boy. The boy's mother, who years earlier traded away all claim on the family money to keep her children, spends months bargaining in two directions at once — with the men mutilating her son, and with the grandfather whose price for the ransom is the children themselves.

predicaments.situation: a loved one is taken away by strangers
predicaments.basis: Paul is seized in Rome by the 'Ndrangheta, held in a remote farmhouse in the south, sold on to a second crime family, and has an ear cut off and mailed to a newspaper.

predicaments.situation: the only one able to help refuses
predicaments.basis: Getty, the richest private citizen in the world, will not pay the $17 million, arguing that paying once invites the kidnapping of every other grandchild, and sends a negotiator to investigate instead.

predicaments.situation: a rescue is granted only on cruel terms
predicaments.basis: Getty agrees to the reduced $4 million only if Gail signs full custody of all her children over to their near-comatose father — in effect to Getty — and then pays just the $1 million his lawyers can deduct.

predicaments.situation: a life is bought back for a price
predicaments.basis: After months of haggling the ransom is settled, counted at a drop point, and Paul's release is called in from a construction site.

predicaments.situation: a captor comes to protect his captive
predicaments.basis: Cinquanta, who has guarded and negotiated for Paul throughout, advises him to run and then attacks the man sent to kill him so the boy can reach his mother.

relatives.title: High and Low
relatives.shares: a fortune's owner deciding whether a boy's life is worth what it would cost him

relatives.title: Ransom
relatives.shares: a wealthy parent refusing the demand on principle while the child is held

relatives.title: Dog Day Afternoon
relatives.shares: a captor siding with the person he is holding against his own side

relatives.title: Okja
relatives.shares: a life bought back for a price from a holder who thinks only in transactions

films.title: Prisoners
films.engine: Two small girls disappear on Thanksgiving afternoon, and one girl's father, certain the police have let the culprit go, takes the man himself and keeps him in an empty building, hurting him for an answer that never comes; the other girl's parents find out and decide to let it continue. Meanwhile the detective works the same case by ordinary means, and the woman who actually took the children turns out to have taken them precisely in order to make parents into what this father is becoming.

predicaments.situation: a loved one is taken away by strangers
predicaments.basis: Anna Dover and Joy Birch vanish from outside their homes after playing on a parked RV, and are drugged and held for days in a neighbouring house.

predicaments.situation: someone is punished for what he cannot explain
predicaments.basis: Alex Jones, whose intellect and stutter make him unable to account for himself, whispers one ambiguous line to Keller and is then chained and beaten for days over a whispered maze he half-remembers from his own abduction.

predicaments.situation: a witness keeps silent about what he saw
predicaments.basis: Franklin Birch helps hold Alex and is on the point of freeing him when Nancy talks him out of it; the couple then neither stop Keller nor tell Loki what is happening in the building.

predicaments.situation: the bereaved makes others suffer the same loss
predicaments.basis: Holly explains that after their son died of cancer she and her husband began abducting children to wage a war on God and to turn the surviving parents into demons — Alex was the first, Bob Taylor the second.

predicaments.situation: a search for the lost destroys the searcher
predicaments.basis: Keller's hunt ends with him shot, sealed in a pit in Holly's yard holding his daughter's whistle, while his daughter is carried to hospital by the detective he obstructed.

relatives.title: Mystic River
relatives.shares: a father's certainty about who took his child, acted on before anyone checks it

relatives.title: The Vanishing (1988)
relatives.shares: a search for a taken loved one that consumes the searcher entirely

relatives.title: Memories of Murder
relatives.shares: investigators beating an answer out of a man who cannot explain himself

relatives.title: Changeling
relatives.shares: a parent told what happened to her child by people who have it wrong

films.title: The Dust of Time
films.engine: A man and a woman are arrested and pulled apart on the night they finally spend together, and then spend nearly fifty years crossing borders toward each other — each one arriving to find the other has already built a life elsewhere. A third man loves her across the whole span and is never the one she chooses; the son she put alone on a train at three grows up to have a daughter who disappears in turn into a derelict building.

predicaments.situation: two people are kept apart for decades
predicaments.basis: Spyros and Eleni are arrested and separated the night Stalin's death is announced in Temirtau, and do not marry until she is found working in an Ontario bar in the winter of 1974.

predicaments.situation: a parent sends a child away to survive
predicaments.basis: In Siberia in 1956 Eleni puts her three-year-old son on a train to Moscow to be raised by Jacob's older sister.

predicaments.situation: one returns too late to be taken back
predicaments.basis: Eleni finally tracks Spyros down in the New York suburbs in the summer of 1974 and leaves without speaking to him when she sees he has married someone else.

predicaments.situation: one loves a person already given to another
predicaments.basis: Jacob is ditched at the tram in 1953, crosses the Hungarian border with Eleni on New Year's Eve 1973 only to be sent on to Israel, visits the reunited couple in Berlin in 1999, and drowns himself in the Spree.

predicaments.situation: a family retrieves a child gone astray
predicaments.basis: A's melancholic daughter barricades herself among addicts and vagabonds in an old Berlin building, and Eleni goes in and brings her out shortly before her own death.

relatives.title: Doctor Zhivago
relatives.shares: two people kept apart for decades by the state and the borders it draws

relatives.title: In the Mood for Love
relatives.shares: arriving too late at the place where the other person was

relatives.title: Sophie's Choice
relatives.shares: a parent forced to put a child out of her own hands to survive

relatives.title: An Affair to Remember
relatives.shares: a reunion missed by circumstance and carried unspoken for years afterwards

films.title: Faithless
films.engine: A woman lets a friendship with the man closest to her household become an affair, and once the marriage breaks, everyone starts using what the others love most as leverage: her husband uses the daughter to get her body back, her lover uses her past to punish her, and she gives up the pregnancy that was meant to prove her fitness. Decades later an old man sits her down and makes her tell it all back to him, in order.

predicaments.situation: a spouse leaves for the closest friend
predicaments.basis: Marianne, married to the conductor Markus, agrees first only to share a bed in nightwear with her friend David, then begins the affair in Paris where their separate trips give them cover.

predicaments.situation: another's happiness is unbearable to the one watching
predicaments.basis: David presses Marianne for her sexual history and reacts with violent jealousy when she says Markus satisfied her as no one else had.

predicaments.situation: two households claim the same child
predicaments.basis: Markus sues for full custody of Isabelle and Marianne's lawyer tells her that having left the home puts her at a disadvantage, so she and David marry and conceive to look like a better home.

predicaments.situation: the one with power names an intimate price
predicaments.basis: Markus asks Marianne to meet him alone, supposedly for Isabelle's sake, and there offers to settle the custody case in exchange for sex.

predicaments.situation: a man interrogates the woman he has imagined
predicaments.basis: An aging director conjures Marianne and questions her through the whole account of the affair, and at his farewell she tells him she expects they will meet again.

relatives.title: A Separation
relatives.shares: a custody case decided less by who loves the child than by who holds the advantage

relatives.title: Kramer vs. Kramer
relatives.shares: leaving the home becomes the argument used against a parent's claim to the child

relatives.title: Jules and Jim
relatives.shares: the friend of the house becomes the lover, and the friendship cannot survive it

relatives.title: Le Mépris
relatives.shares: jealousy about what a spouse felt with someone else corrodes the new couple

relatives.title: The Sweet Hereafter
relatives.shares: an older man draws out a woman's account of a wound and turns it into his own material

films.title: The Salt of the Earth
films.engine: A man driven out of his own country builds a life out of standing in front of other people's dying and photographing it — famine camps, war refugees — until, going back to see what became of the people he shot in Rwanda, he stops believing the looking does anything. His wife's idea to replant his father's exhausted ranch gives him a second thing to point a camera at.

predicaments.situation: a witness records suffering he cannot stop
predicaments.basis: Salgado photographs the Ethiopian famine and the largest refugee camps, watching people die of hunger, cholera and cold, and describes the famine as a failure of distribution rather than a natural disaster.

predicaments.situation: a person loses belief in his own work
predicaments.basis: Returning a year later to the Rwandan refugees he had photographed, Salgado is so dispirited by what he finds that he loses hope for humanity and questions the point of what he does.

predicaments.situation: a partner's suggestion redirects the other's whole life
predicaments.basis: Lélia buys the camera that turns an economist into a photographer, and later proposes reforesting the ruined family land, which gives him the subject of his final project.

predicaments.situation: a man returns to the home he fled
predicaments.basis: Salgado, homesick after leaving Brazil for political reasons, works his way around the rest of the Americas before finally moving back to Minas Gerais.

predicaments.situation: a son takes up what his father cannot
predicaments.basis: He and Lélia leave Paris to run his ailing father's failing ranch, and turn the depleted ground into the Instituto Terra.

relatives.title: Cameraperson
relatives.shares: a career spent pointing a camera at other people's catastrophes, and the question of what that did

relatives.title: Nostalgia for the Light
relatives.shares: a person who has made looking at atrocity into a discipline

relatives.title: The Biggest Little Farm
relatives.shares: a couple decides to bring dead ground back and organises years of their life around it

relatives.title: Sans Soleil
relatives.shares: an image-maker doubting whether his images of distant suffering are worth anything

relatives.title: Dersu Uzala
relatives.shares: a man's return to unspoiled land after years of documenting human wreckage

films.title: Megalopolis
films.engine: An architect who wants to demolish a decaying city and replace it with something better is opposed by the man who actually runs it, and the fight becomes personal when that man's daughter attaches herself to the builder and gets pregnant. Around them a cousin farms the city's poor for outrage against the project so he can inherit a bank and then a mob, and everyone's private grievance — a dead wife, a discarded mistress, a dying uncle — gets spent as ammunition in a public argument about whether anyone is allowed to promise a future.

predicaments.situation: a promised future is bought with present hunger
predicaments.basis: Cesar spends his family fortune building Megalopolis in the rubble while ordinary Romans live in poverty, and Cicero argues a casino's immediate tax revenue would serve the city better.

predicaments.situation: a mourner is accused of causing the death
predicaments.basis: Cicero prosecuted Cesar for murdering his vanished wife although Cesar was acquitted and privately believes she killed herself because he neglected her for his work.

predicaments.situation: a father tries to break his child's attachment
predicaments.basis: Cicero begs Cesar to leave the pregnant Julia and offers, as payment, his confession that he prosecuted Cesar knowing the wife's death was suicide.

predicaments.situation: the one with power names an intimate price
predicaments.basis: Wow Platinum freezes Cesar's account at the family bank to force him to leave Julia and marry her instead.

predicaments.situation: a kinsman waits for an elder to fail
predicaments.basis: Clodio Pulcher works on the declining Crassus to get control of the bank, and taunts him once he is bedridden, until Crassus kills Wow and wounds Pulcher with a hidden bow.

predicaments.situation: a rival is disgraced by an engineered scandal
predicaments.basis: Pulcher leaks paparazzi footage of Cesar with the supposedly teenage singer Vesta Sweetwater, and Julia clears him by proving Vesta faked her age.

relatives.title: Metropolis
relatives.shares: a visionary's city built above a suffering population, with a child of the ruling house standing between the sides

relatives.title: The Fountainhead
relatives.shares: an architect who will not compromise his design against the men who fund and administer the city

relatives.title: Coriolanus
relatives.shares: a demagogue turning the ordinary population against a patrician for his own ascent

relatives.title: Ran
relatives.shares: an ageing patriarch's heirs manoeuvring for the inheritance as his mind gives out

relatives.title: Citizen Kane
relatives.shares: a man building monuments while the woman closest to him becomes something he deploys

films.title: Star Wars: Episode I – The Phantom Menace
films.engine: A blockade of one small planet turns out to be a machine for making its own senator the leader of the whole republic: the man who ordered the invasion is the man who offers to fix it. Cutting across that, an older teacher becomes convinced a nine-year-old slave is the prophesied one, buys his freedom off his mother, defies the council that forbids training him, and dies handing the boy to a student who has just been made a knight and does not want him.

predicaments.situation: the rescuer secretly arranged the danger
predicaments.basis: Darth Sidious backs the Trade Federation's blockade and invasion of Naboo, and Senator Palpatine then uses the crisis to have Valorum ousted and himself elected Chancellor.

predicaments.situation: someone sees a gift in an overlooked person
predicaments.basis: Qui-Gon senses the Force in Watto's nine-year-old slave Anakin, wagers the hyperdrive part and the boy's freedom on a podrace, and declares him the Chosen One.

predicaments.situation: a child leaves the one who raised him
predicaments.basis: Anakin's freedom is won but his mother Shmi's is not, and he leaves her behind on Tatooine to be trained, as the Jedi require.

predicaments.situation: elders refuse what one of them has promised
predicaments.basis: The Jedi Council rejects Qui-Gon's request to train Anakin as too old and vulnerable to the dark side, Qui-Gon vows to train him anyway, and Yoda only reluctantly relents after Qui-Gon's death.

predicaments.situation: a mentor dies leaving the student his task
predicaments.basis: Darth Maul mortally wounds Qui-Gon, who with his last words asks Obi-Wan to train Anakin; Obi-Wan is knighted and takes the boy as his apprentice.

predicaments.situation: an institution discards the one who served it
predicaments.basis: Amidala is persuaded to call a vote of no confidence in Chancellor Valorum, who had dispatched the Jedi on her behalf, and he is replaced.

relatives.title: Beasts of No Nation
relatives.shares: a man who sees a use for a boy takes him from his mother and trains him

relatives.title: Richard III
relatives.shares: a schemer manufactures the crisis he then presents himself as the remedy for

relatives.title: Whale Rider
relatives.shares: the elders refuse to train the child one of their own insists is the promised one

relatives.title: Excalibur
relatives.shares: a teacher stakes everything on a boy said to be destined, and does not live to finish him

relatives.title: The Battle of Algiers
relatives.shares: an occupation provoked deliberately so that the response can justify what comes next

films.title: To Catch a Killer
films.engine: A beat officer says out loud that the mass shooter is not crazy but swatting mosquitos, and the agent running the case hears something in that and takes her onto his team. When the investigation kills bystanders, the bureau fires him and she keeps working the case with him off the books; he is shot dead in front of her, and she finishes it by letting the killer believe she understands him. Then the same bureau offers her a career for keeping quiet about what it did.

predicaments.situation: someone sees a gift in an overlooked person
predicaments.basis: Lammark overhears patrol officer Eleanor Falco arguing that the shooter is 'swatting mosquitos' rather than insane, and pulls her out of the department to be his personal liaison.

predicaments.situation: an institution discards the one who served it
predicaments.basis: After Lammark's superiors order the raid on the wrong man, which kills bystanders and wounds his own agent, the Bureau blames him for the investigation's failures and fires him.

predicaments.situation: a mentor dies leaving the student his task
predicaments.basis: Dean shoots Lammark from the shed at his parents' house, and Eleanor, alone in the kitchen with the killer, has to finish the hunt herself.

predicaments.situation: a parent asks a child to end himself
predicaments.basis: Dean's mother, who had agreed to help on the promise he would be taken alive, walks to the shed and begs him to surrender or kill himself, then kills herself.

predicaments.situation: the hunted asks the pursuer to end him
predicaments.basis: Believing Eleanor has come to understand him, Dean asks her to let him fall asleep and then execute him, and turns on her when the sheriff's arrival looks like betrayal.

predicaments.situation: advancement is offered in exchange for silence
predicaments.basis: The Bureau offers Eleanor a senior analyst post if she stays quiet about the malfeasance that got Lammark killed; she takes it after extracting public honours for him, his husband's full pension, and a special agent's badge.

relatives.title: The Silence of the Lambs
relatives.shares: a senior investigator plucks an untried woman onto a manhunt because of how she thinks about the killer

relatives.title: M
relatives.shares: the hunted man finally speaks and asks to be understood by the people closing in

relatives.title: Memories of Murder
relatives.shares: investigators broken and discredited by a case the institution above them keeps mishandling

relatives.title: Serpico
relatives.shares: the institution's own failure is settled by buying the honest officer's silence

relatives.title: Zodiac
relatives.shares: a hunt that outlasts the careers of everyone officially assigned to it

films.title: Like Father, Like Son
films.engine: Two couples are told six years late that their sons were swapped in the hospital, and have to decide whether the child is the one they made or the one they raised. A father who has been mostly absent pushes hardest for the biological exchange, on the grounds that blood decides — and only after handing his son away does he find, on his own camera, the photographs the boy had been quietly taking of him asleep.

predicaments.situation: a child leaves the one who raised him
predicaments.basis: After months of visits, the Nonomiyas and Saikis exchange Keita and Ryūsei permanently; both boys shut down, and Ryūsei runs away back to the Saiki house.

predicaments.situation: two households claim the same child
predicaments.basis: Ryōta, comparing his money and drive with the Saikis' shop-keeping life, proposes taking both boys permanently, which offends Yukari and Yūdai.

predicaments.situation: a parent learns he was loved without knowing
predicaments.basis: Going through his camera, Ryōta finds a cache of pictures Keita had taken of him, mostly asleep, and breaks down.

predicaments.situation: one parent judges another's way of raising
predicaments.basis: Ryōta treats the Saikis as lacking money and ambition while they are shown to understand the bond between parent and child better than he does, and he finally apologises to Keita for his failures as a father.

predicaments.situation: another's happiness is unbearable to the one watching
predicaments.basis: The nurse admits in court that she swapped the babies deliberately, envious of the Nonomiyas' happiness while she struggled as a newlywed with her stepchildren.

predicaments.situation: a wrong is admitted too late to punish
predicaments.basis: The nurse confesses to the deliberate switch but the statute of limitations has run, and when Ryōta comes to her flat to return her apology money and berate her, her stepson steps in to defend her.

relatives.title: Shoplifters
relatives.shares: whether the family that raised a child outranks the one that produced them

relatives.title: Three Identical Strangers
relatives.shares: children deliberately placed in the wrong homes and the adults who have to live with the result

relatives.title: Secrets & Lies
relatives.shares: a household reorganised around a child who arrives from the other side of a birth record

relatives.title: Tokyo Story
relatives.shares: a parent discovering the affection that was there all along only once the chance to return it has narrowed

relatives.title: Kramer vs. Kramer
relatives.shares: a work-absorbed father learning what his son actually is only when the boy is about to be taken from him

films.title: Unknown Pleasures
films.engine: Three young people in a factory city have been handed no work, no future and no story of their own, so they borrow their gestures from movies, pop songs and gangsters, and try to live inside them. Every attempt to become somebody — winning a woman who belongs to a hard man, enlisting, staging a robbery — collides with a body, a debt or a police station. The film is about what people do with a life that nobody has asked them to lead.

predicaments.situation: the young are left with nothing to do
predicaments.basis: Unemployed Bin Bin watches television with his girlfriend while Xiao Ji rides his motorbike in circles around Datong, neither of them expected anywhere by anyone.

predicaments.situation: the young imitate strangers to become someone
predicaments.basis: Having talked about American crime films, Xiao Ji straps a fake bomb to Bin Bin and drives him to a bank to rob it as they have seen it done on screen.

predicaments.situation: a man courts a woman promised to another
predicaments.basis: Xiao Ji pursues Qiao Qiao, the liquor company's dancer, whose boyfriend Qiao San has his men beat and humiliate him for it.

predicaments.situation: one hides bad news by pushing love away
predicaments.basis: Rejected by the army because he has hepatitis, Bin Bin borrows money to buy his girlfriend a phone and then refuses her when she comes close, saying he has no future.

relatives.title: I Vitelloni
relatives.shares: young men with no work and no expected place drifting through a provincial town

relatives.title: Bande à part
relatives.shares: a crime attempted because the participants have seen it done in films

relatives.title: Rebels of the Neon God
relatives.shares: aimless youth circling a city on motorbikes with nothing asked of them

relatives.title: Bonnie and Clyde
relatives.shares: people adopting an outlaw persona borrowed from popular story

relatives.title: Los Olvidados
relatives.shares: the young left outside every institution that could take them in

films.title: Panic Room
films.engine: A newly divorced woman and her diabetic daughter spend their first night in a strange house, and three men break in for something hidden in the one room built to keep people safe. Locking themselves in that room saves them and also puts them exactly where the intruders need them to be, so every protective move costs something — the child's medicine is outside, the phone call brings her ex-husband into the house as a hostage, and the police at the door must be lied to. The film is a mother rationing what she can give up.

predicaments.situation: the safest place is the one they want
predicaments.basis: Meg and Sarah shut themselves in the panic room, which is precisely where the floor safe with the bearer bonds the intruders came for is located.

predicaments.situation: a parent leaves safety to save the child
predicaments.basis: Sarah's glucagon syringes are in her bedroom, so Meg must open the steel door and go out into the house while her daughter is seizing.

predicaments.situation: a child is taken to force a parent
predicaments.basis: The men get Sarah inside the panic room and then prepare to leave with her as a hostage, which is what finally makes Meg come out and fight.

predicaments.situation: an accomplice balks at what the plan requires
predicaments.basis: Burnham, who built the room, gives Sarah her medication, refuses the killing Raoul is willing to do, and finally shoots Raoul to save Meg before being arrested.

predicaments.situation: help must be turned away to stay safe
predicaments.basis: Two officers arrive at the door on a 911 call and Meg, with the men holding her daughter's fate in the house, convinces them nothing is wrong.

predicaments.situation: the one called for help becomes another hostage
predicaments.basis: Meg taps the phone line to reach her ex-husband Stephen, who drives over and is captured and beaten in front of the camera so she will watch.

relatives.title: Wait Until Dark
relatives.shares: a woman alone in her own home outmaneuvering men who came in for something hidden there

relatives.title: The Desperate Hours
relatives.shares: a household held inside its own house by intruders while outsiders must be sent away

relatives.title: Aliens
relatives.shares: a woman whose every decision is bent around keeping one child alive

relatives.title: Rififi
relatives.shares: a robbery destroyed by one member willing to go further than the others

relatives.title: Don't Breathe
relatives.shares: a break-in where the shelter and the prize occupy the same locked space

films.title: The Ghost Writer
films.engine: A writer is hired to finish another man's book after that man drowns, and finishing it means retracing his steps — the same car, the same route, the same questions. What he uncovers is not the leader's guilt but the fact that the person standing closest to the leader all along was the one running him. The film is about doing a dead man's job carefully enough to inherit his death.

predicaments.situation: one man steps into a dead man's place
predicaments.basis: The nameless ghostwriter takes over Adam Lang's memoir after Mike McAra drowns, works from his manuscript, drives his car and follows the route already stored in its navigation.

predicaments.situation: learning too much makes a person disposable
predicaments.basis: McAra found what Lang's premiership was really serving and died on a beach where the tides could not have left him; the Ghost, having read the same thing, is struck by a car in the street.

predicaments.situation: the closest confidant is working for someone else
predicaments.basis: Ruth Lang, the wife who steers her husband's decisions, was recruited by Professor Paul Emmett while he tutored her at Harvard.

predicaments.situation: one takes the blame for another's decisions
predicaments.basis: Lang faces the International Criminal Court over rendition and torture flights while the choices that made him useful were being routed through his wife.

predicaments.situation: the dead leave word for whoever comes next
predicaments.basis: McAra buried his finding in the first word of each chapter of the original manuscript, where only the next ghostwriter would ever look.

relatives.title: The Third Man
relatives.shares: a man investigating a friend's suspicious death and finding out what the friend actually was

relatives.title: The Parallax View
relatives.shares: an outsider assembling a truth that makes him the next body

relatives.title: Chinatown
relatives.shares: an inquiry into public corruption that resolves into a secret inside one family

relatives.title: Notorious
relatives.shares: the intimate at a powerful man's side placed there by an intelligence service

relatives.title: Blow-Up
relatives.shares: a hired professional whose ordinary work accidentally contains the evidence

films.title: The Triangle
films.engine: Four friends and a salvage crew board a derelict liner adrift in fog, and one of them, standing over a vault of money with an old bat in his hand, kills his own fiancée and then hunts the rest. The ship has done this before — the survivors learn he is repeating, gesture for gesture, a passenger from its last voyage. The film is about a group discovering that the danger is a person they arrived with.

predicaments.situation: a friend becomes the thing the group fears
predicaments.basis: Stu, who came aboard with his fiancée and his two oldest friends, kills Julia in the vault and then pursues Tommy and Charlie through the ship.

predicaments.situation: the one who intervenes is killed for it
predicaments.basis: Julia tries to stop Stu from taking the money and he kills her in a rage; Captain Morgan, working alone in the engine room, is mortally wounded when Stu finds him.

predicaments.situation: the living repeat a crime of the dead
predicaments.basis: Morgan tells Tommy before dying that Stu is behaving exactly like the passenger on the Queen of Scots' final voyage who killed everyone aboard with a cricket bat.

predicaments.situation: learning too much makes a person disposable
predicaments.basis: Once Tommy and Charlie find Gus's body and Julia's bloodied flashlight, Stu locks them in the ballast compartment and floods it.

relatives.title: The Shining
relatives.shares: a man in an isolated place taking up the violence of someone who was there before him

relatives.title: The Thing
relatives.shares: a sealed group where the threat is one of the people who arrived with them

relatives.title: Dead Calm
relatives.shares: a derelict vessel at sea whose survivor turns out to be the danger

relatives.title: Kwaidan
relatives.shares: the living forced to re-enact what was done aboard a lost ship

relatives.title: The Treasure of the Sierra Madre
relatives.shares: found money turning a companion against his own party

films.title: Adaptation
films.engine: A writer who cannot bear invention is paid to make a film out of a book with no story in it, while his cheerful identical twin, with no talent and no doubt, writes a formula thriller and sells it immediately. Trying to fill his blank pages he goes to look at the author himself, sees what she is hiding, and is nearly killed for it — so the plot he refused to write arrives and happens to him. The film is a man watching his brother be easily what he cannot be, and only afterwards learning to say things out loud.

predicaments.situation: a twin does easily what the other cannot
predicaments.basis: Donald moves into Charlie's house, takes up screenwriting on a whim, follows a seminar formula, and sells his thriller for six or seven figures while Charlie stares at a blank page.

predicaments.situation: a man cannot say what he feels aloud
predicaments.basis: Charlie is too shy to introduce himself to Orlean in her own office, and only at the end tells Amelia he loves her.

predicaments.situation: a respectable person hides a shameful attachment
predicaments.basis: Susan Orlean, the writer of the book, is secretly Laroche's lover and takes the drug made from the ghost orchid with him.

predicaments.situation: learning too much makes a person disposable
predicaments.basis: Caught watching Orlean and Laroche together, Charlie is driven into the swamp at gunpoint because she decides he cannot be allowed to expose them.

predicaments.situation: an accomplice balks at what the plan requires
predicaments.basis: Laroche tells Orlean that killing Charlie is not necessary and hesitates again when he finds him in the swamp, while she insists.

relatives.title: Barton Fink
relatives.shares: a writer paralyzed by his own scruples while the work he despises is what pays

relatives.title: 8½
relatives.shares: an artist unable to make the commissioned work, who ends up making the failure itself

relatives.title: Rear Window
relatives.shares: an observer seen by the people he is watching and pursued for it

relatives.title: Dead Ringers
relatives.shares: identical brothers, one able to move through the world the other cannot

relatives.title: The Double Life of Véronique
relatives.shares: a person confronted with a version of themselves living the easier life

films.title: Avatar: The Way of Water
films.engine: A man who left his own species to lead another now has children, and when the invaders return with a copy of the enemy he killed, he chooses to abandon the people he leads and run, asking a coastal clan to take his family in as strangers. The enemy turns out to be raising a human boy who is his own son, and hunts Jake by threatening whatever he loves — his children, then the sea creatures the clan is bonded to. The film is a father learning that flight only relocates the people who will be hurt for him.

predicaments.situation: a family in flight asks strangers for shelter
predicaments.basis: Jake takes his wife and children away from the Omatikaya to the eastern reefs, where Tonowari's Metkayina grant them asylum.

predicaments.situation: outsiders must earn a place among the settled
predicaments.basis: The Sully children must learn the water ways of the Metkayina and are stranded and taunted by Aonung and his friends before they are accepted.

predicaments.situation: a child is taken to force a parent
predicaments.basis: Quaritch seizes Lo'ak, Tsireya, Tuk and Kiri and demands Jake surrender himself in exchange for them.

predicaments.situation: a boy is claimed by the enemy father
predicaments.basis: Spider, raised by human scientists among the Na'vi, is recognized by the recombinant Quaritch as his son and courted by him, and finally pulls him from the water only to walk away.

predicaments.situation: one man steps into a dead man's place
predicaments.basis: The RDA implants the memories of the dead Colonel Quaritch into a Na'vi body, which resumes his hunt and his fatherhood where he left them.

predicaments.situation: a child dies saving the others
predicaments.basis: Neteyam is fatally shot while pulling Lo'ak, Tsireya and Spider out of the sinking ship.

relatives.title: The Empire Strikes Back
relatives.shares: a boy confronted by a father who is the enemy and wants him back

relatives.title: Dances with Wolves
relatives.shares: a man from the invading side living as a member of the people being invaded

relatives.title: Apocalypto
relatives.shares: a father hiding his family while the force hunting him burns through the region

relatives.title: Grave of the Fireflies
relatives.shares: displaced children dependent on strangers who may or may not take them in

relatives.title: The Road
relatives.shares: a parent whose every decision is measured against keeping a child alive in flight

films.title: The Attorney
films.engine: A tax lawyer who got rich by taking the cases nobody argued about is asked to defend the son of the woman who used to feed him for free, and discovers the boy's confession was beaten out of him. The film is about a comfortable man being pulled, one hearing at a time, into a room where the police, the prosecutor and the judge have already agreed on the answer — and about what it costs the one honest witness who breaks that agreement.

predicaments.situation: an onlooker is drawn into another's fight
predicaments.basis: Song has spent years profiting from real-estate and tax work and mocking student protesters, until the tortured students' trial makes him the only lawyer in the room arguing.

predicaments.situation: those in power deny what was done
predicaments.basis: Cha takes the stand and swears the defendants' bruises were self-inflicted, while the court rules that ordinary constitutional protections do not apply to national-security cases.

predicaments.situation: a person is punished for telling the truth
predicaments.basis: Lt Yoon testifies that the detainees were tortured and describes the methods, and his superiors immediately frame him for desertion so his account is void and he goes to prison.

predicaments.situation: a mother searches for a son taken away
predicaments.basis: Choi closes her restaurant and hunts for Park for nearly two months before learning he is being tried for sedition.

relatives.title: The Official Story
relatives.shares: a comfortable professional is forced to learn what the state has been doing and cannot go back

relatives.title: Z
relatives.shares: an investigator meets an official version of events that everyone in authority has agreed to repeat

relatives.title: The Insider
relatives.shares: the one witness willing to testify is destroyed before the testimony can land

relatives.title: In the Name of the Father
relatives.shares: confessions extracted under torture are treated by a court as evidence

relatives.title: Judgment at Nuremberg
relatives.shares: a courtroom where the law itself is what is on trial

films.title: Bugonia
films.engine: A man whose mother was left comatose by a drug trial decides that the executive responsible is not a person at all but an alien, and kidnaps her to force a confession. She spends four days working out which version of his story he most wants to hear, and feeding it back to him — two people each trying to talk the other into a world, with one of them right for reasons the other never learns.

predicaments.situation: a captive must talk their captor into freedom
predicaments.basis: Chained in a basement with her head shaved, Michelle first tries to turn Don against Teddy, then invents an antidote, then finally tells Teddy the origin story of his own conspiracy in order to be driven out of the house.

predicaments.situation: one person sees what nobody else will believe
predicaments.basis: Teddy's account of Andromedans killing the bees and steering humanity is treated by everyone around him as illness, and it is substantially true.

predicaments.situation: someone hunts for a person to blame
predicaments.basis: Sandy's coma came out of an Auxolith clinical trial, and Teddy converts a company into a single body he can tie to a chair and hurt.

predicaments.situation: a captor falls for the person he holds
predicaments.basis: Don asks Michelle only to be taken into space with her, and shoots himself the moment she promises it.

predicaments.situation: a vigil is kept beside someone past answering
predicaments.basis: Teddy's whole scheme is aimed at waking Sandy, and it ends with him injecting antifreeze into her IV in the belief it is a cure.

relatives.title: Misery
relatives.shares: a captive keeps herself alive by managing the fantasy her captor needs to keep believing

relatives.title: The Collector
relatives.shares: a man imprisons a woman in a basement and expects her to confirm his account of who she is

relatives.title: Rosemary's Baby
relatives.shares: the person everyone treats as deluded turns out to have read the situation correctly

relatives.title: Take Shelter
relatives.shares: a man wrecks the lives around him acting on a warning only he can hear

relatives.title: Sympathy for Mr. Vengeance
relatives.shares: a grievance against a system gets converted into one abducted body

films.title: Postcard
films.engine: A middle-aged conscript, sure he will not come back, hands a comrade a postcard from his wife and asks him to tell her he read it. He dies; the comrade lives; and the war works through the wife's household one member at a time — the husband, then his brother she is married off to, then his parents — until she is the only one left standing in it. The film is the stranger finally arriving at her door with a message he cannot make worth anything.

predicaments.situation: a message is entrusted to a passing stranger
predicaments.basis: Sadazo gives Matsuyama his wife's postcard before shipping out to the Philippines, asking him to tell Tomoko he received it, and Matsuyama carries it home years after the war ends.

predicaments.situation: a widow is handed to her husband's brother
predicaments.basis: Yukichi and Chiyo beg Tomoko not to leave after Sadazo's death notice and marry her to Sanpei, who is conscripted and killed in turn.

predicaments.situation: a family is emptied around the one left
predicaments.basis: Both sons die at the front, Yukichi dies of his heart in the fields, and Chiyo gives Tomoko money and hangs herself, leaving Tomoko alone in the house.

predicaments.situation: a returning man finds his place already taken
predicaments.basis: Matsuyama comes back from the war to learn his wife left after an affair with his father and is working as a bar hostess in Osaka, and she tells him she wishes he had died.

relatives.title: Ugetsu
relatives.shares: a man comes back from a war to a household the war has already finished with

relatives.title: The Best Years of Our Lives
relatives.shares: the returning survivor finds his place at home quietly occupied by someone else

relatives.title: The Deer Hunter
relatives.shares: the one who came back stands in front of the people the dead man belonged to

relatives.title: Twenty-Four Eyes
relatives.shares: a war counted out through one woman as the men around her are taken one by one

relatives.title: Letters from a Dead Man
relatives.shares: a message meant for the living outlives everyone it concerned

films.title: A Taxi Driver
films.engine: A broke single father steals another driver's fare — a foreigner who will pay well for a run to a city that has been sealed off — and only works out on arrival what he has driven into. He gets out, hears on the radio the version of events the country is being given, and turns the car around. The film is about a man with every reason to stay out of it going back, and about a debt between two people that neither can ever settle because one of them gave a false name.

predicaments.situation: an onlooker is drawn into another's fight
predicaments.basis: Man-seob takes the Gwangju job purely for the 100,000 won, abandons Peter once, and returns after hearing the broadcast blaming North Korean infiltrators for what he watched himself.

predicaments.situation: those in power deny what was done
predicaments.basis: Soldiers fire on civilians including the people carrying the wounded, while the national media reports that outside infiltrators caused the chaos; Peter's footage is the only counter-account.

predicaments.situation: a message is entrusted to a passing stranger
predicaments.basis: As the plainclothes officers drag him away, Jae-sik shouts at Peter to get the footage out to the world, and Peter eventually broadcasts it.

predicaments.situation: a rescuer vanishes before thanks can be given
predicaments.basis: At the airport Man-seob writes a false name and a cigarette company's phone number in Peter's notebook, and Peter spends the rest of his life looking for a man who does not exist.

predicaments.situation: a mother searches for a son taken away
predicaments.basis: Man-seob's one detour on his way out is to drive an old woman to the hospital to look for her son, who proves to be one of the students.

relatives.title: The Killing Fields
relatives.shares: a foreign journalist's story only exists because a local man stayed with him, and the local is the one left behind

relatives.title: Under Fire
relatives.shares: an outsider with a camera and the locals who take the risk of getting the footage out

relatives.title: Salvador
relatives.shares: a man in it for the money finds he cannot keep filming from outside

relatives.title: The Year of Living Dangerously
relatives.shares: a foreign reporter dependent on a local companion inside a city about to break

relatives.title: Hotel Rwanda
relatives.shares: an ordinary man with a job and a family becomes the reason strangers survive

films.title: The Spiderwick Chronicles
films.engine: A nine-year-old is dragged by his mother to a ruined house in the country when what he wants is his father in the city, and he finds a book proving the house is besieged by creatures nobody else can see. Being disbelieved about the monsters and being wrong about which parent left him are the same wound, and the siege is what finally makes his mother listen — and makes him stop waiting for the phone call that is never coming.

predicaments.situation: one person sees what nobody else will believe
predicaments.basis: Jared, given a seeing-stone by Thimbletack, is the only one who can see the goblins and Mulgarath, and his mother and siblings treat his account as acting out over the divorce.

predicaments.situation: a child blames one parent for the other
predicaments.basis: Jared tells Helen he hates her and wants to live with his father, until Mallory tells him their father moved in with another woman.

predicaments.situation: a child waits for a parent's promised return
predicaments.basis: Jared keeps trying to reach Richard by phone and gets nothing, and at the end refuses to live with him at all.

predicaments.situation: one is held where time no longer passes
predicaments.basis: Arthur has been kept by the sylphs for eighty years without ageing while his daughter Lucinda grew old in a psychiatric hospital, and he will turn to dust if he stays in the world.

predicaments.situation: an enemy wears the face of a parent
predicaments.basis: Mulgarath arrives in the house as Richard, and Jared, catching something wrong in how his father speaks, stabs him.

relatives.title: Pan's Labyrinth
relatives.shares: a child moved into a hostile house sees a world the adults will not credit, while the real danger is domestic

relatives.title: Coraline
relatives.shares: a child alone in a new house is offered a better version of a parent by something that wants to eat her

relatives.title: The Squid and the Whale
relatives.shares: a boy sides fiercely with the parent who actually left

relatives.title: A Monster Calls
relatives.shares: a boy's monster is inseparable from what is happening to his family

relatives.title: Spirited Away
relatives.shares: a resentful child dragged to a new home is the only one who can act once the household is taken

films.title: The Past
films.engine: A man flies back to France after four years to sign the divorce papers and walks into the middle of his ex-wife's new household — a teenage daughter refusing the new man, and the new man's wife lying comatose after swallowing bleach. Everyone in the house wants to know who caused that, and every answer hands the guilt to the next person along, until it stops at someone whose confession still doesn't settle it.

predicaments.situation: someone hunts for a person to blame
predicaments.basis: Lucie confesses to forwarding the affair emails, Naïma turns out to have given her the address, and Naïma insists the wife never read them and had reasons of her own — the cause keeps moving one person further back.

predicaments.situation: an onlooker is drawn into another's fight
predicaments.basis: Ahmad comes only to finalise the divorce and ends up counselling Lucie, searching for her when she runs, brokering between her and Marie, and pushing for the truth to be told.

predicaments.situation: a child blames one parent for the other
predicaments.basis: Lucie refuses to accept Samir and Marie's pregnancy, and her sabotage of the affair is aimed at her mother; Marie throws her out over it before going after her.

predicaments.situation: a returning man finds his place already taken
predicaments.basis: Ahmad arrives to learn from the car that Marie is with Samir, is put in a room with Samir's son Fouad, and is told at the courthouse that she is pregnant.

predicaments.situation: a vigil is kept beside someone past answering
predicaments.basis: Samir brings perfumes to the hospital on the doctors' advice, sprays his cologne on his neck and asks his comatose wife to squeeze his hand; a tear runs down her face and nothing else is certain.

relatives.title: A Separation
relatives.shares: a household's crisis turns on tracing responsibility back through a chain of half-truths, and the tracing damages everyone

relatives.title: Rashomon
relatives.shares: each account of the same event relocates the guilt

relatives.title: Talk to Her
relatives.shares: a man conducts a whole relationship beside a woman who cannot answer him

relatives.title: Ordinary People
relatives.shares: a family works through who is to blame for a suicide attempt it will not discuss directly

relatives.title: Autumn Sonata
relatives.shares: a daughter finally puts to her mother the charge she has been carrying for years

films.title: Rolling Thunder Revue: A Bob Dylan Story by Martin Scorsese
films.engine: A singer gathers his old friends from a folk scene into a travelling show at a low, sour moment in the country's life, and everyone who touches it wants it to have meant something for them — a reporter angling his way inside, a young woman convinced a song was written for her, a poet trying to become the kind of artist people still want, a filmmaker who says he only agreed to talk in order to claim the footage as his. The one person who could say what it was refuses to: he opens by announcing he remembers nothing and that the whole thing was about nothing. The film is the gap between a man who will not account for his own past and the crowd of people living off it.

predicaments.situation: a man cannot account for his own past
predicaments.basis: Dylan opens the film saying he remembers nothing of the Rolling Thunder Revue and that he cannot get to its core because "it's about nothing."

predicaments.situation: several people claim the same shared past
predicaments.basis: Van Dorp says he sat for the interview only to stake his claim over the tour footage that makes up most of the film, while Ginsberg tells the viewer what the tour was for and Dylan denies it was for anything.

predicaments.situation: an outsider tries to join a closed circle
predicaments.basis: Larry 'Ratso' Sloman, sent by a magazine to write about the tour, spends it trying to ingratiate himself into Dylan's inner circle; Sharon Stone is folded in through costumes and decides a song was about her.

predicaments.situation: an old lover tries to rekindle what ended
predicaments.basis: Joan Baez sings alongside Dylan onstage and dresses in his stage clothes in an attempt to revive their romance.

predicaments.situation: strangers act to free a condemned man
predicaments.basis: Dylan interrupts the tour to press executives to rush out "Hurricane" for Rubin Carter, wrongly convicted of murder, and a congressman recalls persuading the president to intervene; the campaign ends in a retrial and release.

relatives.title: Close-Up
relatives.shares: an outsider talking his way into a famous circle, and a film that will not settle what actually happened

relatives.title: F for Fake
relatives.shares: a narrator who undermines his own account of the events he is narrating

relatives.title: Almost Famous
relatives.shares: a reporter attached to a touring company trying to become one of them

relatives.title: Rashomon
relatives.shares: several people claiming incompatible ownership of the same past

relatives.title: The Thin Blue Line
relatives.shares: an outside campaign built to overturn a wrongful conviction

films.title: Tokyo Family
films.engine: An elderly couple come up from their island to see the children they raised, and discover that each child's life has precisely no room in it — an outing cancelled for work, a house too small, a hotel booked to move them out of the way, an evening where the two of them have to sleep apart because nobody can take them in. The only person who gives them any real attention is the one not yet in the family, the younger son's fiancée. When the mother dies on the trip, the father hands that outsider what is left of his wife and asks her to look after his son.

predicaments.situation: the old are passed between their grown children
predicaments.basis: Shukichi and Tomiko are moved from the eldest son's house to the daughter's salon to a hotel and back, each stay ended by work, cramped rooms or a neighbourhood meeting.

predicaments.situation: a stranger gives the care family withholds
predicaments.basis: Noriko, the fiancée who is not yet family, spends warm time with Tomiko and stays on the island afterwards to look after Shukichi, which none of his own children do.

predicaments.situation: an outsider tries to join a closed circle
predicaments.basis: Noriko travels with the body to the island funeral and worries the whole time that the family has not accepted her.

predicaments.situation: someone dies while a guest in another home
predicaments.basis: Tomiko collapses on the stairs at Koichi's house on her way to her grandson's room, falls into a coma and dies the next morning, far from the island.

predicaments.situation: a parent entrusts a child to an outsider
predicaments.basis: Before returning to Tokyo, Shukichi thanks Noriko, gives her Tomiko's watch as a keepsake and asks her to take care of Shoji.

relatives.title: Make Way for Tomorrow
relatives.shares: an old couple separated for the night because no child has room for both of them

relatives.title: Umberto D.
relatives.shares: an old person discovering they have no place in anyone's life

relatives.title: Aparajito
relatives.shares: a parent waiting on a child whose life has moved somewhere else

relatives.title: The Farewell
relatives.shares: a family drawn together by a death and unable to be honest inside it

relatives.title: Still Walking
relatives.shares: grown children performing duty toward parents while counting the hours

films.title: Daisy
films.engine: A man who kills for a living falls in love with a woman he cannot go near, so he does everything for her from a distance — replaces the log she fell from with a bridge, returns her lost bag, sends her flowers at the same minute every day — and she credits all of it to a policeman who sits for her portraits and lets her keep believing it, because saying otherwise would expose him. Each of the three then tries to protect one of the others and takes something irreparable off them: her voice, then two lives.

predicaments.situation: an anonymous gift is credited to another man
predicaments.basis: Hye-young decides the daily daisies and the new bridge come from Jeong Woo, the detective having his portrait drawn, while Park Yi, who sent them, says nothing and Jeong Woo stays silent to protect his cover.

predicaments.situation: a man loves someone he must not approach
predicaments.basis: Park Yi watches Hye-young paint in the mountains and keeps his distance for years, certain his work as a hit man would destroy her if he came near.

predicaments.situation: someone loves the wrong person by mistake
predicaments.basis: Hye-young falls for Jeong Woo on the strength of gifts he never sent, and is still in love with him after he is transferred away.

predicaments.situation: a man conceals his work from the beloved
predicaments.basis: Park Yi hides that he is a contract killer and Jeong Woo hides that he is an undercover officer working a drug ring, and both silences turn out to be lethal.

predicaments.situation: one person dies in another's place
predicaments.basis: Hye-young is first shot in the neck shielding Jeong Woo, losing her voice, and later steps into the bullet fired at Park Yi and is killed.

relatives.title: Cyrano de Bergerac
relatives.shares: a man's courtship reaching the woman under another man's name, and neither of them correcting her

relatives.title: The Killer
relatives.shares: a contract killer who blinds a woman by accident and spends the rest of the film trying to protect her

relatives.title: Le Samouraï
relatives.shares: a hired killer whose trade forbids him any attachment he actually wants

relatives.title: The Shop Around the Corner
relatives.shares: a woman in love with an unseen correspondent while the man himself stands in front of her saying nothing

relatives.title: Love Letter
relatives.shares: a devotion carried out at a distance that its object only understands too late
